```sol
contract StorageTest {
    uint256 public exists = 1;
    mapping(address => uint256) public map_addr;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public map_uint;
    mapping(address => uint256) public map_packed;
    mapping(address => UnpackedStruct) public map_struct;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public deep_map;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => UnpackedStruct)) public deep_map_struct;
    UnpackedStruct public basic;

    uint248 public tA;
    bool public tB;

    bool public tC = false;
    uint248 public tD = 1;

    struct UnpackedStruct {
        uint256 a;
        uint256 b;
    }

    mapping(address => bool) public map_bool;

    bytes32 public tE = hex"1337";
    address public tF = address(1337);
    int256 public tG = type(int256).min;
    bool public tH = true;
    bytes32 private tI = ~bytes32(hex"1337");

    uint256 randomPacking;

    // Array with length matching values of elements.
    uint256[] public edgeCaseArray = [3, 3, 3];

    // Signed fields narrower than 256 bits. `tJ`/`tK` share a slot; `tSolo` is pushed into a
    // slot of its own by the `uint256` that follows it.
    int64 public tJ = -5;
    uint64 public tK = 7;

    int8 public tSolo = -1;
    uint256 public tAfterSolo = 1;

    constructor() {
        basic = UnpackedStruct({a: 1337, b: 1337});

        uint256 two = (1 << 128) | 1;
        map_packed[msg.sender] = two;
        map_packed[address(uint160(1337))] = 1 << 128;
    }

    function read_struct_upper(address who) public view returns (uint256) {
        return map_packed[who] >> 128;
    }

    function read_struct_lower(address who) public view returns (uint256) {
        return map_packed[who] & ((1 << 128) - 1);
    }

    function hidden() public view returns (bytes32 t) {
        bytes32 slot = keccak256("my.random.var");
        assembly ("memory-safe") {
            t := sload(slot)
        }
    }

    function const() public pure returns (bytes32 t) {
        t = bytes32(hex"1337");
    }

    function extra_sload() public view returns (bytes32 t) {
        // trigger read on slot `tE`, and make a staticcall to make sure compiler doesn't optimize this SLOAD away
        assembly {
            pop(staticcall(gas(), sload(tE.slot), 0, 0, 0, 0))
        }
        t = tI;
    }

    function setRandomPacking(uint256 val) public {
        randomPacking = val;
    }

    function _getMask(uint256 size) internal pure returns (uint256 mask) {
        assembly {
            // mask = (1 << size) - 1
            mask := sub(shl(size, 1), 1)
        }
    }

    function setRandomPacking(uint256 val, uint256 size, uint256 offset) public {
        // Generate mask based on the size of the value
        uint256 mask = _getMask(size);
        // Zero out all bits for the word we're about to set
        uint256 cleanedWord = randomPacking & ~(mask << offset);
        // Place val in the correct spot of the cleaned word
        randomPacking = cleanedWord | val << offset;
    }

    function getRandomPacked(uint256 size, uint256 offset) public view returns (uint256) {
        // Generate mask based on the size of the value
        uint256 mask = _getMask(size);
        // Shift to place the bits in the correct position, and use mask to zero out remaining bits
        return (randomPacking >> offset) & mask;
    }

    function getRandomPacked(uint8 shifts, uint8[] memory shiftSizes, uint8 elem) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(elem < shifts, "!elem");
        uint256 leftBits;
        uint256 rightBits;

        for (uint256 i; i < shiftSizes.length; i++) {
            if (i < elem) {
                leftBits += shiftSizes[i];
            } else if (elem != i) {
                rightBits += shiftSizes[i];
            }
        }

        // we may have some right bits unaccounted for
        leftBits += 256 - (leftBits + shiftSizes[elem] + rightBits);

        // clear left bits, then clear right bits and realign
        return (randomPacking << leftBits) >> (leftBits + rightBits);
    }
}

// Minimal mock of a reflection token: `balanceOf` reads many storage slots
// and always returns a constant, so no single slot mutation can change its
// return value and stdStorage can never find a matching slot.
contract MockReflectionToken {
    uint256 internal _a = 1;
    uint256 internal _b = 2;
    uint256 internal _c = 3;
    mapping(address => uint256) internal _balances;

    constructor() {
        _balances[msg.sender] = 1000 ether;
    }

    // Reads _a, _b, _c, and _balances[account] but always returns a constant.
    // This means mutating any single slot won't change the return value.
    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 x = _a + _b + _c + _balances[account];
        x; // suppress unused warning
        return 42;
    }
}
```

```sol
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT OR Apache-2.0
pragma solidity >=0.8.13 <0.9.0;

import {Test, stdToml} from "../src/Test.sol";

contract StdTomlTest is Test {
    using stdToml for string;

    string root;
    string path;

    function setUp() public {
        root = vm.projectRoot();
        path = string.concat(root, "/test/fixtures/test.toml");
    }

    struct SimpleToml {
        uint256 a;
        string b;
    }

    struct NestedToml {
        uint256 a;
        string b;
        SimpleToml c;
    }

    function test_readToml() public view {
        string memory json = vm.readFile(path);
        assertEq(json.readUint(".a"), 123);
    }

    function test_writeToml() public {
        string memory json = "json";
        json.serialize("a", uint256(123));
        string memory semiFinal = json.serialize("b", string("test"));
        string memory finalJson = json.serialize("c", semiFinal);
        finalJson.write(path);

        string memory toml = vm.readFile(path);
        bytes memory data = toml.parseRaw("$");
        NestedToml memory decodedData = abi.decode(data, (NestedToml));

        assertEq(decodedData.a, 123);
        assertEq(decodedData.b, "test");
        assertEq(decodedData.c.a, 123);
        assertEq(decodedData.c.b, "test");
    }
}
```

```sol
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT OR Apache-2.0
pragma solidity >=0.8.13 <0.9.0;

import {Test, StdUtils} from "../src/Test.sol";

contract StdUtilsMock is StdUtils {
    // We deploy a mock version so we can properly test expected reverts.
    function exposedGetTokenBalances(address token, address[] memory addresses)
        external
        returns (uint256[] memory balances)
    {
        return getTokenBalances(token, addresses);
    }

    function exposedBound(int256 num, int256 min, int256 max) external pure returns (int256) {
        return bound(num, min, max);
    }

    function exposedBound(uint256 num, uint256 min, uint256 max) external pure returns (uint256) {
        return bound(num, min, max);
    }

    function exposedBytesToUint(bytes memory b) external pure returns (uint256) {
        return bytesToUint(b);
    }
}

contract StdUtilsTest is Test {
    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
                                     BOUND UINT
    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/

    function test_Bound() public pure {
        assertEq(bound(uint256(5), 0, 4), 0);
        assertEq(bound(uint256(0), 69, 69), 69);
        assertEq(bound(uint256(0), 68, 69), 68);
        assertEq(bound(uint256(10), 150, 190), 174);
        assertEq(bound(uint256(300), 2800, 3200), 3107);
        assertEq(bound(uint256(9999), 1337, 6666), 4669);
    }

    function test_Bound_WithinRange() public pure {
        assertEq(bound(uint256(51), 50, 150), 51);
        assertEq(bound(uint256(51), 50, 150), bound(bound(uint256(51), 50, 150), 50, 150));
        assertEq(bound(uint256(149), 50, 150), 149);
        assertEq(bound(uint256(149), 50, 150), bound(bound(uint256(149), 50, 150), 50, 150));
    }

    function test_Bound_EdgeCoverage() public pure {
        assertEq(bound(uint256(0), 50, 150), 50);
        assertEq(bound(uint256(1), 50, 150), 51);
        assertEq(bound(uint256(2), 50, 150), 52);
        assertEq(bound(uint256(3), 50, 150), 53);
        assertEq(bound(type(uint256).max, 50, 150), 150);
        assertEq(bound(type(uint256).max - 1, 50, 150), 149);
        assertEq(bound(type(uint256).max - 2, 50, 150), 148);
        assertEq(bound(type(uint256).max - 3, 50, 150), 147);
    }

    function testFuzz_Bound_DistributionIsEven(uint256 min, uint256 size) public pure {
        size = size % 100 + 1;
        min = bound(min, UINT256_MAX / 2, UINT256_MAX / 2 + size);
        uint256 max = min + size - 1;
        uint256 result;

        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= size * 4; ++i) {
            // x > max
            result = bound(max + i, min, max);
            assertEq(result, min + (i - 1) % size);
            // x < min
            result = bound(min - i, min, max);
            assertEq(result, max - (i - 1) % size);
        }
    }

    function testFuzz_Bound(uint256 num, uint256 min, uint256 max) public pure {
        if (min > max) (min, max) = (max, min);

        uint256 result = bound(num, min, max);

        assertGe(result, min);
        assertLe(result, max);
        assertEq(result, bound(result, min, max));
        if (num >= min && num <= max) assertEq(result, num);
    }

    function test_BoundUint256Max() public pure {
        assertEq(bound(0, type(uint256).max - 1, type(uint256).max), type(uint256).max - 1);
        assertEq(bound(1, type(uint256).max - 1, type(uint256).max), type(uint256).max);
    }

    function test_RevertIf_BoundMaxLessThanMin() public {
        // We deploy a mock version so we can properly test the revert.
        StdUtilsMock stdUtils = new StdUtilsMock();

        vm.expectRevert(bytes("StdUtils bound(uint256,uint256,uint256): Max is less than min."));

    }

    }

        assertEq(bound(type(int256).min + 3, -50, 150), -47);
        assertEq(bound(type(int256).min, 10, 150), 10);

        assertEq(bound(type(int256).min + 2, 10, 150), 12);
```

```sol
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT OR Apache-2.0
pragma solidity >=0.8.13 <0.9.0;

import {StdSecp256k1} from "../../src/StdSecp256k1.sol";

// Exercise the standalone library in the compiler and via-ir CI matrix.
contract CompilationStdSecp256k1 {
    function identities() external pure returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        (uint256 x, uint256 y) = StdSecp256k1.identityAffine();
        (uint256 px, uint256 py, uint256 pz) = StdSecp256k1.identityProjective();
        return (x, y, px, py, pz);
    }

    function generators() external pure returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        (uint256 x, uint256 y) = StdSecp256k1.generatorAffine();
        (uint256 px, uint256 py, uint256 pz) = StdSecp256k1.generatorProjective();
        return (x, y, px, py, pz);
    }

    function predicates(uint256 x, uint256 y, uint256 z, uint256 scalar)
        external
        pure
        returns (bool, bool, bool, bool, bool)
    {
        return (
            StdSecp256k1.isIdentityAffine(x, y),
            StdSecp256k1.isIdentityProjective(x, y, z),
            StdSecp256k1.isOnCurve(x, y),
            StdSecp256k1.isValidScalar(scalar),
            StdSecp256k1.isValidNonZeroScalar(scalar)
        );
    }

    function encodings(uint256 x, uint256 y) external pure returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, address) {
        return (
            StdSecp256k1.yParity(y),
            StdSecp256k1.yParityEthereum(y),
            StdSecp256k1.yCompressed(y),
            StdSecp256k1.toAddress(x, y)
        );
    }
}
```

`contracts/src/QuarterhoodBoards.sol`:

```sol
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity 0.8.28;

/// @title QuarterhoodBoards
/// @notice Every Monday, Quarterhood writes one Merkle root per finished week: the top rows of every weekly board
///         (game, mode, rank, player, score, run id, replay hash). Once a week is committed it can never change,
///         so anyone can prove later that a board shown on the site is the board that was locked that Monday.
/// @dev    No funds, no tokens, no upgrades. Only the operator wallet set at deploy time can commit, and only once
///         per week. Leaf and tree format: see `leafOf` and the README.
contract QuarterhoodBoards {
    /// @notice The only address allowed to commit. Fixed at deploy.
    address public immutable operator;

    /// @notice week (UTC Monday as "YYYY-MM-DD", left-aligned in bytes32) => Merkle root of that week's boards.
    mapping(bytes32 week => bytes32 root) public rootOf;

    event WeekCommitted(bytes32 indexed week, bytes32 root, uint32 boards, uint32 rows);

    error NotOperator();
    error AlreadyCommitted(bytes32 week);
    error EmptyRoot();

    constructor(address operator_) {
        operator = operator_;
    }

    /// @notice Lock a finished week. `boards` and `rows` are informational counts for the event.
    function commit(bytes32 week, bytes32 root, uint32 boards, uint32 rows) external {
        if (msg.sender != operator) revert NotOperator();
        if (root == bytes32(0)) revert EmptyRoot();
        if (rootOf[week] != bytes32(0)) revert AlreadyCommitted(week);
        rootOf[week] = root;
        emit WeekCommitted(week, root, boards, rows);
    }

    /// @notice The leaf for one board row. Off-chain code must hash rows exactly like this.
    function leafOf(
        bytes32 week,
        bytes32 game,
        bytes32 mode,
        uint32 rank,
        address player,
        uint64 score,
        bytes16 runId,
        uint32 replayHash
    ) public pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(bytes.concat(keccak256(abi.encode(week, game, mode, rank, player, score, runId, replayHash))));
    }

    /// @notice Checks a row against a committed week (sorted-pair Merkle proof, same as OpenZeppelin MerkleProof).
    function verify(bytes32 week, bytes32 leaf, bytes32[] calldata proof) external view returns (bool) {
        bytes32 h = leaf;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < proof.length; i++) {
            bytes32 p = proof[i];
            h = h < p ? keccak256(abi.encode(h, p)) : keccak256(abi.encode(p, h));
        }
        bytes32 root = rootOf[week];
        return root != bytes32(0) && h == root;
    }
}

```

`contracts/test/QuarterhoodBoards.t.sol`:

```sol
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity 0.8.28;

import {Test} from "forge-std/Test.sol";
import {QuarterhoodBoards} from "../src/QuarterhoodBoards.sol";

contract QuarterhoodBoardsTest is Test {
    QuarterhoodBoards boards;
    address op = address(0xA11CE);
    bytes32 constant WEEK = "2026-11-23";

    function setUp() public {
        boards = new QuarterhoodBoards(op);
    }

    function _pair(bytes32 a, bytes32 b) internal pure returns (bytes32) {
        return a < b ? keccak256(abi.encode(a, b)) : keccak256(abi.encode(b, a));
    }

    function test_commitOnlyOperator() public {
        vm.expectRevert(QuarterhoodBoards.NotOperator.selector);
        boards.commit(WEEK, bytes32(uint256(1)), 1, 1);
        vm.prank(op);
        boards.commit(WEEK, bytes32(uint256(1)), 1, 1);
        assertEq(boards.rootOf(WEEK), bytes32(uint256(1)));
    }

    function test_commitOncePerWeek() public {
        vm.startPrank(op);
        boards.commit(WEEK, bytes32(uint256(1)), 1, 1);
        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(QuarterhoodBoards.AlreadyCommitted.selector, WEEK));
        boards.commit(WEEK, bytes32(uint256(2)), 1, 1);
    }

    function test_emptyRootRefused() public {
        vm.prank(op);
        vm.expectRevert(QuarterhoodBoards.EmptyRoot.selector);
        boards.commit(WEEK, bytes32(0), 0, 0);
    }

    function test_eventEmitted() public {
        vm.expectEmit(true, false, false, true);
        emit QuarterhoodBoards.WeekCommitted(WEEK, bytes32(uint256(7)), 12, 300);
        vm.prank(op);
        boards.commit(WEEK, bytes32(uint256(7)), 12, 300);
    }

    function test_verifyThreeLeaves() public {
        bytes32 a = boards.leafOf(WEEK, "coin-stack", "ranked", 1, address(1), 410, bytes16(uint128(1)), 0x94b79f1e);
        bytes32 b = boards.leafOf(WEEK, "coin-stack", "ranked", 2, address(2), 300, bytes16(uint128(2)), 0x11111111);
        bytes32 c = boards.leafOf(WEEK, "hood-dash", "ranked", 1, address(3), 990, bytes16(uint128(3)), 0x22222222);
        bytes32 ab = _pair(a, b);
        bytes32 root = _pair(ab, c);
        vm.prank(op);
        boards.commit(WEEK, root, 2, 3);
        bytes32[] memory p = new bytes32[](2);
        p[0] = b;
        p[1] = c;
        assertTrue(boards.verify(WEEK, a, p));
        bytes32[] memory pc = new bytes32[](1);
        pc[0] = ab;
        assertTrue(boards.verify(WEEK, c, pc));
        // a changed score is a different leaf
        bytes32 forged = boards.leafOf(WEEK, "coin-stack", "ranked", 1, address(1), 999, bytes16(uint128(1)), 0x94b79f1e);
        assertFalse(boards.verify(WEEK, forged, p));
        // an uncommitted week never verifies
        assertFalse(boards.verify("2026-11-30", a, p));
    }

    function testFuzz_onlyOperator(address who, bytes32 root) public {
        vm.assume(who != op && root != bytes32(0));
        vm.prank(who);
        vm.expectRevert(QuarterhoodBoards.NotOperator.selector);
        boards.commit(WEEK, root, 1, 1);
    }

    /// The site's TypeScript (app/shared/boards.ts) must hash leaves and pairs exactly like the contract.
    function test_matchesOffchainTree() public {
        bytes32 a = boards.leafOf(WEEK, "coin-stack", "ranked", 1, address(1), 410, bytes16(uint128(1)), 0x94b79f1e);
        assertEq(a, 0x9ef86a13c27e6ef67fa71ed189cfded7066188892be692515393b04551a7082e);
        bytes32 root = 0xc5fd1a873b91639805aee622b0f1407dd00bfe52bdbda16536c51c86c231d0a0;
        vm.prank(op);
        boards.commit(WEEK, root, 2, 3);
        bytes32[] memory p = new bytes32[](2);
        p[0] = 0x541d62c1777d9b9038de45e0c757d02723c05c8ee761015a748278f466a10ff5;
        p[1] = 0xd80d85183f897352fe6f7d33122ffc4e5fb65ed5be3fe0ec4300cf3abd7d815b;
        assertTrue(boards.verify(WEEK, a, p));
    }
}
```

`src/engine.ts`:

```ts
// Deterministic game core shared by the browser and the Worker.
// The browser plays a run and records its inputs; the Worker replays the same inputs from the same seed
// and only accepts the score it computes itself. Games use integers only (no Math.sin, no float drift),
// so V8 in Chrome, JavaScriptCore in Safari and workerd all reach the same state frame by frame.

export const FPS = 60;

/** xorshift32 over a uint32 state. Same sequence on every JS engine. */
export class Rng {
  private s: number;
  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.s = seed >>> 0 || 0x9e3779b9;
  }
  next(): number {
    let x = this.s;
    x ^= x << 13;
    x >>>= 0;
    x ^= x >>> 17;
    x ^= x << 5;
    x >>>= 0;
    this.s = x;
    return x;
  }
  /** Integer in [lo, hi]. */
  int(lo: number, hi: number): number {
    return lo + (this.next() % (hi - lo + 1));
  }
  get state(): number {
    return this.s;
  }
}

/** One input: the frame it applies to and an action code the game defines. */
export type InputEvent = readonly [frame: number, action: number];

export interface Game<S> {
  id: string;
  /** Hard stop so a replay can never run forever. */
  maxFrames: number;
  /** Action codes this game accepts. Anything else rejects the run. */
  actions: readonly number[];
  /** For games whose actions carry a value (a shot at a screen point): accepts codes beyond `actions`. */
  isAction?(a: number): boolean;
  init(seed: number): S;
  /** Advance one frame. `actions` are the inputs recorded for this frame, in order. */
  step(s: S, actions: readonly number[]): void;
  over(s: S): boolean;
  score(s: S): number;
}

export type ReplayResult<S = unknown> =
  | { ok: true; score: number; frames: number; hash: number; state: S }
  | { ok: false; reason: string };

/** Cheap rolling hash of a run's final numbers, logged with the score to spot client/server drift. */
export function mix(h: number, v: number): number {
  h ^= v >>> 0;
  h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0;
  return h;
}

/**
 * Replays a run. Events must be sorted by frame, inside [0, maxFrames), use known actions,
 * and stop at the frame the game ended (no inputs after game over).
 */
export function replay<S>(
  game: Game<S>,
  seed: number,
  events: readonly InputEvent[],
  hashState?: (s: S) => number,
): ReplayResult<S> {
  if (events.length > game.maxFrames) return { ok: false, reason: "too_many_inputs" };
  let prev = -1;
  for (const ev of events) {
    if (!Array.isArray(ev) || ev.length !== 2) return { ok: false, reason: "bad_event" };
    const [f, a] = ev;
    if (!Number.isInteger(f) || f < 0 || f >= game.maxFrames) return { ok: false, reason: "bad_frame" };
    if (f < prev) return { ok: false, reason: "unsorted" };
    if (!(game.isAction ? game.isAction(a) : game.actions.includes(a))) return { ok: false, reason: "bad_action" };
    prev = f;
  }
  const s = game.init(seed);
  let i = 0;
  let frame = 0;
  const now: number[] = [];
  while (frame < game.maxFrames && !game.over(s)) {
    now.length = 0;
    while (i < events.length && events[i][0] === frame) now.push(events[i++][1]);
    game.step(s, now);
    frame++;
  }
  if (i < events.length) return { ok: false, reason: "inputs_after_end" };
  return { ok: true, score: game.score(s), frames: frame, hash: hashState ? hashState(s) : 0, state: s };
}

/** Records inputs during live play, in the exact shape `replay` expects. */
export class Recorder {
  readonly events: InputEvent[] = [];
  push(frame: number, action: number) {
    this.events.push([frame, action]);
  }
}

```

`src/games/brawl.ts`:

```ts
// Harbor Brawl: a one-on-one fight in a rope ring on a harbour deck. Tap to jab, hold and let go for a
// heavy punch, hold the guard to block. Every rival shows its punch before it lands: block just as it comes
// in for a parry, or land a heavy during the wind-up for a counter. Knock a rival down and a tougher one steps in.
// Integer frame counts only, so the Worker replays it exactly.

import { type Game, Rng, mix } from "../engine.ts";

export const ACT = { punchDown: 1, punchUp: 2, guardDown: 3, guardUp: 4 } as const;

export const PLAYER_HP = 100;
const HEAVY_HOLD = 22; // frames of holding before a release throws a heavy
const PARRY = 9; // guard raised this many frames before the impact or fewer = parry
const MAX_FRAMES = 60 * 240;

export type PState = "idle" | "jab" | "heavy" | "recoil" | "hurt";
export type FState = "idle" | "guard" | "windup" | "strike" | "recover" | "stun" | "down";

export interface BrawlState {
  frame: number;
  rng: Rng;
  round: number; // 1-based: the rival number
  php: number;
  fhp: number;
  fmax: number;
  // player
  p: PState;
  pt: number; // frames into the current state
  pHeavyReady: boolean; // the release that started this punch was a heavy
  hold: number; // frames the punch button has been held, -1 when up
  guard: boolean;
  guardAt: number; // frame the guard went up
  // rival
  f: FState;
  ft: number;
  fLen: number; // frames this rival state lasts
  fHand: 0 | 1; // which hand the coming punch uses (for the view)
  // what just happened, for sounds and sparks
  last: "jab" | "heavy" | "counter" | "blocked" | "parry" | "chip" | "hit" | "ko" | null;
  lastAt: number;
  dealt: number;
  parries: number;
  counters: number;
  kos: number;
  end: "ko" | "time" | null;
  score: number;
}

const windupLen = (s: BrawlState) => Math.max(14, 40 - s.round * 4) + s.rng.int(0, Math.max(4, 12 - s.round));
const recoverLen = (s: BrawlState) => Math.max(18, 38 - s.round * 3);
const strikeDmg = (s: BrawlState) => 9 + Math.min(12, s.round * 2);

/** read through a function: hurtRival() can change the rival's state mid-branch */
const knockedDown = (s: BrawlState) => s.f === "down";

function setF(s: BrawlState, f: FState, len: number) {
  s.f = f;
  s.ft = 0;
  s.fLen = len;
}
function note(s: BrawlState, e: BrawlState["last"]) {
  s.last = e;
  s.lastAt = s.frame;
}
function hurtRival(s: BrawlState, dmg: number) {
  s.fhp = Math.max(0, s.fhp - dmg);
  s.dealt += dmg;
  if (s.fhp === 0) {
    s.kos++;
    setF(s, "down", 130);
    note(s, "ko");
  }
}

/** The player's punch connects: what it does depends on what the rival is doing. */
function land(s: BrawlState, heavy: boolean) {
  if (s.f === "down") return;
  if (s.f === "guard") {
    if (heavy) {
      // a heavy breaks the guard
      hurtRival(s, 8);
      if (!knockedDown(s)) setF(s, "stun", 30);
      note(s, "heavy");
    } else {
      note(s, "blocked");
      s.p = "recoil";
      s.pt = 0;
    }
    return;
  }
  if (s.f === "windup") {
    // only a heavy breaks a wind-up; a jab just glances off and the punch still comes
    if (heavy) {
      s.counters++;
      hurtRival(s, 22);
      if (!knockedDown(s)) setF(s, "stun", 44);
      note(s, "counter");
    } else {
      hurtRival(s, 3);
      if (!knockedDown(s)) note(s, "jab");
    }
    return;
  }
  hurtRival(s, heavy ? 15 : 5);
  if (!knockedDown(s) && heavy) setF(s, "stun", 22);
  if (!knockedDown(s)) note(s, heavy ? "heavy" : "jab");
}

function nextRival(s: BrawlState) {
  s.round++;
  s.fmax = 50 + s.round * 20;
  s.fhp = s.fmax;
  s.php = Math.min(PLAYER_HP, s.php + 25);
  setF(s, "idle", 50);
}

export const HarborBrawl: Game<BrawlState> = {
  id: "harbor-brawl",
  maxFrames: MAX_FRAMES,
  actions: [ACT.punchDown, ACT.punchUp, ACT.guardDown, ACT.guardUp],
  init(seed) {
    const s: BrawlState = {
      frame: 0,
      rng: new Rng(seed),
      round: 0,
      php: PLAYER_HP,
      fhp: 0,
      fmax: 0,
      p: "idle",
      pt: 0,
      pHeavyReady: false,
      hold: -1,
      guard: false,
      guardAt: -100,
      f: "idle",
      ft: 0,
      fLen: 60,
      fHand: 0,
      last: null,
      lastAt: -100,
      dealt: 0,
      parries: 0,
      counters: 0,
      kos: 0,
      end: null,
      score: 0,
    };
    nextRival(s);
    s.php = PLAYER_HP;
    setF(s, "idle", 70);
    return s;
  },
  step(s, actions) {
    if (s.end) return;
    for (const a of actions) {
      if (a === ACT.punchDown) {
        if (s.hold < 0) s.hold = 0;
      } else if (a === ACT.punchUp) {
        if (s.hold >= 0 && s.p === "idle" && !s.guard) {
          s.p = s.hold >= HEAVY_HOLD ? "heavy" : "jab";
          s.pt = 0;
        }
        s.hold = -1;
      } else if (a === ACT.guardDown) {
        if (!s.guard) (s.guard = true), (s.guardAt = s.frame);
      } else if (a === ACT.guardUp) s.guard = false;
    }
    if (s.hold >= 0) s.hold++;

    // ---- player ----
    s.pt++;
    if (s.p === "jab") {
      if (s.pt === 6) land(s, false);
      if (s.pt >= 16 && s.p === "jab") s.p = "idle";
    } else if (s.p === "heavy") {
      if (s.pt === 13) land(s, true);
      if (s.pt >= 32 && s.p === "heavy") s.p = "idle";
    } else if (s.p === "recoil") {
      if (s.pt >= 16) s.p = "idle";
    } else if (s.p === "hurt") {
      if (s.pt >= 22) s.p = "idle";
    }

    // ---- rival ----
    s.ft++;
    if (s.f === "strike") {
      // the punch lands on its first frame
      const blocking = s.guard && (s.p === "idle" || s.p === "recoil");
      if (blocking && s.frame - s.guardAt <= PARRY) {
        s.parries++;
        setF(s, "stun", 48);
        note(s, "parry");
      } else if (blocking) {
        s.php = Math.max(0, s.php - 5);
        setF(s, "recover", recoverLen(s));
        note(s, "chip");
      } else {
        s.php = Math.max(0, s.php - strikeDmg(s));
        s.p = "hurt";
        s.pt = 0;
        s.hold = -1;
        setF(s, "recover", recoverLen(s));
        note(s, "hit");
      }
      if (s.php === 0) s.end = "ko";
    } else if (s.ft >= s.fLen) {
      if (s.f === "down") nextRival(s);
      else if (s.f === "windup") setF(s, "strike", 1);
      else if (s.f === "idle" || s.f === "guard") {
        s.fHand = s.rng.int(0, 1) as 0 | 1;
        setF(s, "windup", windupLen(s));
      } else {
        // after recovering or being stunned: wait a while, guard up about half the time
        const len = s.rng.int(Math.max(12, 40 - s.round * 3), Math.max(30, 80 - s.round * 5));
        setF(s, s.rng.int(0, 99) < 45 + Math.min(25, s.round * 3) ? "guard" : "idle", len);
      }
    }

    s.score = s.dealt * 2 + s.kos * 150 + s.parries * 25 + s.counters * 10;
    s.frame++;
    if (!s.end && s.frame >= MAX_FRAMES) s.end = "time";
  },
  over(s) {
    return s.end !== null;
  },
  score(s) {
    return s.score;
  },
};

export function hashBrawl(s: BrawlState): number {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  h = mix(h, s.frame);
  h = mix(h, s.score);
  h = mix(h, s.php);
  h = mix(h, s.fhp);
  h = mix(h, s.round);
  h = mix(h, s.rng.state);
  return h;
}
```

`src/games/bullseye.ts`:

```ts
// Bullseye Wind: the bow's aim sweeps up and down on its own; press to loose the arrow.
// Wind changes before every arrow and pushes the arrow sideways in flight. Three arrows per round;
// a round needs 12 points to go on. Targets move farther and shrink each round. A 5 s shot clock
// looses the arrow if you wait too long.
// Integer-only: angles come from a fixed sine table, positions are in 1/256 px (FP).

import { type Game, Rng, mix } from "../engine.ts";

export const FP = 256;
export const ACTION_SHOOT = 1;
export const BOW = { x: 18, y: 188 }; // px
export const GROUND_Y = 204;
export const ARROWS_PER_ROUND = 3;
export const PASS_POINTS = 12;
const MAX_ROUNDS = 10;
/** Shot clock: after this many frames of aiming the arrow is loosed wherever the bow points. */
export const SHOT_CLOCK = 300;
const MAX_FRAMES = 60 * 300;

// sin(d) * 4096 for d = 0..90, written out so every engine uses identical numbers.
const SIN = [
  0, 71, 143, 214, 286, 357, 428, 499, 570, 641, 711, 782, 852, 921, 991, 1060, 1129, 1198, 1266, 1334, 1401, 1468, 1534,
  1600, 1666, 1731, 1796, 1860, 1923, 1986, 2048, 2110, 2171, 2231, 2290, 2349, 2408, 2465, 2522, 2578, 2633, 2687, 2741,
  2793, 2845, 2896, 2946, 2996, 3044, 3091, 3138, 3183, 3228, 3271, 3314, 3355, 3396, 3435, 3474, 3511, 3547, 3582, 3617,
  3650, 3681, 3712, 3742, 3770, 3798, 3824, 3849, 3873, 3896, 3917, 3937, 3956, 3974, 3991, 4006, 4021, 4034, 4046, 4056,
  4065, 4074, 4080, 4086, 4090, 4094, 4095, 4096,
];

/** sin/cos * 4096 for an angle in tenths of a degree, 0..900. */
export function sinT(t: number): number {
  const d = Math.floor(t / 10);
  const f = t - d * 10;
  if (d >= 90) return SIN[90];
  return SIN[d] + Math.trunc(((SIN[d + 1] - SIN[d]) * f) / 10);
}
export function cosT(t: number): number {
  return sinT(900 - t);
}

const ARROW_V = 1600; // FP per frame (~6.25 px)
const GRAVITY = 22; // FP per frame^2
const AIM_MIN = 0; // tenths of a degree above horizontal
const AIM_MAX = 600;
const SHOW_FRAMES = 40; // pause after an arrow lands

export type BullseyePhase = "aim" | "flight" | "show";

export interface Shot {
  points: number;
  hitY: number | null; // px where it crossed the target, null if it missed the target plane
}

export interface BullseyeState {
  frame: number;
  rng: Rng;
  round: number; // 1-based
  arrow: number; // 0..2 within the round
  roundPoints: number;
  phase: BullseyePhase;
  phaseFrames: number;
  aim: number; // tenths of a degree
  aimDir: 1 | -1;
  aimSpeed: number; // tenths per frame
  wind: number; // FP per frame^2, + pushes right (away from the archer)
  target: { x: number; y: number; r: number }; // px
  arrowX: number; // FP
  arrowY: number;
  vx: number;
  vy: number;
  shots: Shot[];
  tens: number;
  score: number;
  end: "round" | "rounds" | "time" | null;
}

function newRound(s: BullseyeState) {
  const k = s.round - 1;
  s.target = {
    x: Math.min(150, 96 + k * 5 + s.rng.int(0, 10)),
    y: s.rng.int(80, 170),
    r: Math.max(7, 16 - k),
  };
  s.arrow = 0;
  s.roundPoints = 0;
  s.aimSpeed = Math.min(22, 9 + k * 1);
}

function newArrow(s: BullseyeState) {
  s.wind = s.rng.int(-10, 10) * Math.min(3, 1 + Math.floor((s.round - 1) / 3));
  s.phase = "aim";
  s.phaseFrames = 0;
}

function pointsFor(s: BullseyeState, hitY: number): number {
  const d = Math.abs(hitY - s.target.y * FP);
  const r = s.target.r * FP;
  if (d >= r) return 0;
  return 10 - 2 * Math.floor((d * 5) / r);
}

export const Bullseye: Game<BullseyeState> = {
  id: "bullseye-wind",
  maxFrames: MAX_FRAMES,
  actions: [ACTION_SHOOT],
  init(seed) {
    const s: BullseyeState = {
      frame: 0,
      rng: new Rng(seed),
      round: 1,
      arrow: 0,
      roundPoints: 0,
      phase: "aim",
      phaseFrames: 0,
      aim: 0,
      aimDir: 1,
      aimSpeed: 9,
      wind: 0,
      target: { x: 100, y: 120, r: 16 },
      arrowX: 0,
      arrowY: 0,
      vx: 0,
      vy: 0,
      shots: [],
      tens: 0,
      score: 0,
      end: null,
    };
    newRound(s);
    s.aim = s.rng.int(AIM_MIN, AIM_MAX);
    newArrow(s);
    return s;
  },
  step(s, actions) {
    if (s.end) return;
    if (s.phase === "aim") {
      const loose = s.phaseFrames >= SHOT_CLOCK ? [...actions, ACTION_SHOOT] : actions;
      for (const a of loose) {
        if (a === ACTION_SHOOT && s.phase === "aim") {
          s.phase = "flight";
          s.phaseFrames = 0;
          s.arrowX = BOW.x * FP;
          s.arrowY = BOW.y * FP;
          s.vx = Math.trunc((ARROW_V * cosT(s.aim)) / 4096);
          s.vy = -Math.trunc((ARROW_V * sinT(s.aim)) / 4096);
        }
      }
      if (s.phase === "aim") {
        s.aim += s.aimDir * s.aimSpeed;
        if (s.aim >= AIM_MAX) {
          s.aim = AIM_MAX;
          s.aimDir = -1;
        } else if (s.aim <= AIM_MIN) {
          s.aim = AIM_MIN;
          s.aimDir = 1;
        }
      }
    } else if (s.phase === "flight") {
      const ox = s.arrowX;
      const oy = s.arrowY;
      s.vx += s.wind;
      s.vy += GRAVITY;
      s.arrowX += s.vx;
      s.arrowY += s.vy;
      const tx = s.target.x * FP;
      let shot: Shot | null = null;
      if (ox < tx && s.arrowX >= tx) {
        // height where the arrow crossed the target's plane, interpolated inside this frame
        const hitY = oy + Math.trunc(((s.arrowY - oy) * (tx - ox)) / (s.arrowX - ox));
        shot = { points: pointsFor(s, hitY), hitY: Math.floor(hitY / FP) };
      } else if (s.arrowY >= GROUND_Y * FP || s.arrowX <= 0 || s.phaseFrames > 240) {
        shot = { points: 0, hitY: null };
      }
      if (shot) {
        s.shots.push(shot);
        s.roundPoints += shot.points;
        s.score += shot.points;
        if (shot.points === 10) s.tens++;
        s.phase = "show";
        s.phaseFrames = 0;
      }
    } else if (s.phase === "show" && s.phaseFrames >= SHOW_FRAMES) {
      s.arrow++;
      if (s.arrow >= ARROWS_PER_ROUND) {
        if (s.roundPoints < PASS_POINTS) {
          s.end = "round";
        } else if (s.round >= MAX_ROUNDS) {
          s.end = "rounds";
        } else {
          s.score += 5 * s.round; // round bonus
          s.round++;
          newRound(s);
        }
      }
      if (!s.end) newArrow(s);
    }
    s.phaseFrames++;
    s.frame++;
    if (!s.end && s.frame >= MAX_FRAMES) s.end = "time";
  },
  over(s) {
    return s.end !== null;
  },
  score(s) {
    return s.score;
  },
};

export function hashBullseye(s: BullseyeState): number {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  h = mix(h, s.frame);
  h = mix(h, s.score);
  h = mix(h, s.round);
  h = mix(h, s.rng.state);
  for (const sh of s.shots) h = mix(h, sh.points * 1000 + (sh.hitY ?? 999));
  return h;
}

/** Where an arrow loosed now would cross the target plane (px), for bots and tests. Mirrors the flight step. */
export function previewHit(s: BullseyeState, aim: number): number | null {
  let x = BOW.x * FP;
  let y = BOW.y * FP;
  let vx = Math.trunc((ARROW_V * cosT(aim)) / 4096);
  let vy = -Math.trunc((ARROW_V * sinT(aim)) / 4096);
  const tx = s.target.x * FP;
  for (let i = 0; i < 241; i++) {
    const ox = x;
    const oy = y;
    vx += s.wind;
    vy += GRAVITY;
    x += vx;
    y += vy;
    if (ox < tx && x >= tx) return Math.floor((oy + Math.trunc(((y - oy) * (tx - ox)) / (x - ox))) / FP);
    if (y >= GROUND_Y * FP || x <= 0) return null;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * The first part of an arrow's path for a given aim, gravity only (no wind), in px.
 * View-only: the bow's aiming guide. The simulation never calls it.
 */
export function guidePath(aim: number, frames: number, every = 2): { x: number; y: number }[] {
  let x = BOW.x * FP;
  let y = BOW.y * FP;
  const vx = Math.trunc((ARROW_V * cosT(aim)) / 4096);
  let vy = -Math.trunc((ARROW_V * sinT(aim)) / 4096);
  const out: { x: number; y: number }[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= frames; i++) {
    vy += GRAVITY;
    x += vx;
    y += vy;
    if (i % every === 0) out.push({ x: x / FP, y: y / FP });
  }
  return out;
}
```

`src/games/coinstack.ts`:

```ts
// Coin Stack: a carrier swings a coin back and forth; press to drop it on the stack.
// Each coin sits where it lands, so small misses add up and the stack starts to lean.
// The run ends when a coin misses the stack or the stack tips over its own balance point.
// All positions are integers in 1/256 px (FP). The playfield is 160 px wide.

import { type Game, Rng, mix } from "../engine.ts";

export const FP = 256;
export const FIELD_W = 160;
export const COIN_W = 24; // px
export const COIN_H = 6; // px, one coin's thickness in the stack
export const DROP_H = 40; // px between the carrier and the top of the stack
export const ACTION_DROP = 1;

const HALF = (COIN_W / 2) * FP;
const MIN_X = 16 * FP;
const MAX_X = (FIELD_W - 16) * FP;
const GRAVITY = 80; // FP per frame^2
const PERFECT = 2 * FP; // within 2 px of the coin below
const BASE_SPEED = 300; // FP per frame (~1.2 px)
const SPEED_STEP = 14; // added per coin
const MAX_SPEED = 1050; // ~4.1 px per frame
const JITTER = 60; // random extra speed per coin, from the seed
const MAX_FRAMES = 60 * 240; // four minutes

export type EndReason = "miss" | "topple" | "time" | null;

export interface Landing {
  frame: number;
  dx: number; // FP offset from the coin below
  perfect: boolean;
}

export interface CoinStackState {
  frame: number;
  rng: Rng;
  carrierX: number;
  dir: 1 | -1;
  speed: number;
  falling: { x: number; dist: number; vy: number } | null;
  /** x centre of each coin, bottom (base) first. The base coin is fixed at the centre. */
  stack: number[];
  score: number;
  combo: number;
  bestCombo: number;
  perfects: number;
  end: EndReason;
  /** Index of the lowest coin whose load tipped, when end === "topple". */
  tipAt: number;
  /** Where the missed coin would have landed, when end === "miss". */
  missX: number;
  last: Landing | null;
}

/** Coins placed before the carrier reaches its normal speed. The first drops are slow so new players can learn the timing. */
const WARMUP = 4;
const WARMUP_SPEED = 170; // ~0.66 px per frame

function nextSpeed(s: CoinStackState): number {
  const n = s.stack.length - 1;
  if (n < WARMUP) return WARMUP_SPEED + Math.floor(((BASE_SPEED - WARMUP_SPEED) * n) / WARMUP) + s.rng.int(0, JITTER / 3);
  return Math.min(MAX_SPEED, BASE_SPEED + n * SPEED_STEP + s.rng.int(0, JITTER));
}

/** Lowest coin k whose load (all coins above it) has its centre of mass past k's edge, or -1. */
function tipIndex(stack: number[]): number {
  let sum = 0;
  let count = 0;
  let lowest = -1;
  for (let k = stack.length - 1; k >= 1; k--) {
    sum += stack[k];
    count++;
    // |com - stack[k-1]| > HALF, without division: |sum - count*x| > HALF*count
    const off = sum - count * stack[k - 1];
    if (off > HALF * count || off < -HALF * count) lowest = k - 1;
  }
  return lowest;
}

function land(s: CoinStackState) {
  const f = s.falling!;
  s.falling = null;
  const top = s.stack[s.stack.length - 1];
  let x = f.x;
  const dx = x - top;
  if (dx >= COIN_W * FP || dx <= -COIN_W * FP) {
    s.end = "miss";
    s.missX = x;
    s.combo = 0;
    return;
  }
  const perfect = dx <= PERFECT && dx >= -PERFECT;
  if (perfect) x = top;
  s.stack.push(x);
  s.last = { frame: s.frame, dx: x - top, perfect };
  const tip = tipIndex(s.stack);
  if (tip >= 0) {
    s.end = "topple";
    s.tipAt = tip;
    s.combo = 0;
    return;
  }
  if (perfect) {
    s.combo++;
    s.perfects++;
    s.bestCombo = Math.max(s.bestCombo, s.combo);
    s.score += 10 + 5 * Math.min(s.combo, 10);
  } else {
    s.combo = 0;
    s.score += 10;
  }
  s.speed = nextSpeed(s);
}

export const CoinStack: Game<CoinStackState> = {
  id: "coin-stack",
  maxFrames: MAX_FRAMES,
  actions: [ACTION_DROP],
  init(seed) {
    const rng = new Rng(seed);
    const s: CoinStackState = {
      frame: 0,
      rng,
      carrierX: MIN_X + rng.int(0, MAX_X - MIN_X),
      dir: rng.int(0, 1) ? 1 : -1,
      speed: 0,
      falling: null,
      stack: [(FIELD_W / 2) * FP],
      score: 0,
      combo: 0,
      bestCombo: 0,
      perfects: 0,
      end: null,
      tipAt: -1,
      missX: 0,
      last: null,
    };
    s.speed = nextSpeed(s);
    return s;
  },
  step(s, actions) {
    if (s.end) return;
    for (const a of actions) {
      if (a === ACTION_DROP && !s.falling) s.falling = { x: s.carrierX, dist: 0, vy: 0 };
    }
    let x = s.carrierX + s.dir * s.speed;
    if (x > MAX_X) {
      x = MAX_X - (x - MAX_X);
      s.dir = -1;
    } else if (x < MIN_X) {
      x = MIN_X + (MIN_X - x);
      s.dir = 1;
    }
    s.carrierX = x;
    if (s.falling) {
      s.falling.vy += GRAVITY;
      s.falling.dist += s.falling.vy;
      if (s.falling.dist >= DROP_H * FP) land(s);
    }
    s.frame++;
    if (!s.end && s.frame >= MAX_FRAMES) s.end = "time";
  },
  over(s) {
    return s.end !== null;
  },
  score(s) {
    return s.score;
  },
};

export function hashCoinStack(s: CoinStackState): number {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  h = mix(h, s.frame);
  h = mix(h, s.score);
  h = mix(h, s.rng.state);
  for (const x of s.stack) h = mix(h, x);
  return h;
}
```

`src/games/curling.ts`:

```ts
// Frost Curling: slide stones down a frozen lake into the house. Each stone is three presses:
// tap to lock the aim as it swings, tap to lock the power as the bar fills, then hold to sweep while the
// stone runs (sweeping keeps it going and straightens the curl). Red stones already sit on the ice:
// knock them out of the house for points. Four ends of six stones.
// Integer-only physics (positions in 1/256 px) so the Worker replays it exactly.
// Sheet axes: x across (0 = centre line), y down the sheet from the hack.

import { type Game, Rng, mix } from "../engine.ts";
import { isin } from "./vineswing.ts";

export const FP = 256;
export const ACT = { down: 1, up: 2 } as const;
export const STONE_R = 5; // px
export const SHEET_HALF = 30; // px from the centre line to each side board
export const HOUSE_Y = 400; // px: centre of the house
export const BACK_Y = 440; // px: past this a stone is out
export const RINGS = [6, 14, 24] as const; // px radii: button, inner, outer
export const RING_POINTS = [10, 5, 2] as const;
export const STONES_PER_END = 6;
export const ENDS = 4;
export const KNOCK_POINTS = 4;

const FRICTION = 3; // FP px per frame^2 while not swept (0.0117 px)
const SWEEP_FRICTION = 2; // FP px per frame^2 while swept
const CURL_EVERY = 8; // the thrown stone drifts 1/256 px per frame sideways every this many frames
const CURL_EVERY_SWEPT = 24; // sweeping keeps it straighter
const MAX_FRAMES = 60 * 300;
const AIM_MAX = 60; // sideways speed at full aim, FP px per frame (about 30 px across at the house)
const V_MIN = 680; // FP px per frame at zero power: stops about 300 px down
const V_MAX = 900; // at full power: about 520 px, through the house

export interface Stone {
  red: boolean;
  x: number; // FP
  y: number;
  vx: number;
  vy: number;
  out: boolean;
  wasIn: boolean; // a red stone that started the end in the house
}

export type Phase = "aim" | "power" | "slide" | "settle" | "tally";

export interface CurlingState {
  frame: number;
  rng: Rng;
  end: number; // 0-based
  thrown: number; // stones thrown this end
  phase: Phase;
  t: number; // frames into the phase
  aim: number; // -1000..1000 locked aim
  power: number; // 0..1000 locked power
  curl: -1 | 1; // which way this stone curls
  holding: boolean;
  sweeping: boolean;
  stones: Stone[];
  current: number; // index of the moving stone, -1 if none
  endScores: number[];
  knocked: number;
  score: number;
  over: boolean;
}

/** Aim swing (-1000..1000) and power fill (0..1000) at a frame of the phase. */
export function aimAt(t: number): number {
  return Math.trunc((isin(t * 5200) * 1000) / 4096);
}
export function powerAt(t: number): number {
  const p = t % 140; // up and down over 2.3 s
  return p < 70 ? Math.trunc((p * 1000) / 70) : Math.trunc(((140 - p) * 1000) / 70);
}

const dist2 = (ax: number, ay: number, bx: number, by: number) => {
  const dx = (ax - bx) / FP;
  const dy = (ay - by) / FP;
  return dx * dx + dy * dy;
};

export function ringOf(s: Stone): number {
  const d = Math.sqrt(dist2(s.x, s.y, 0, HOUSE_Y * FP));
  for (let i = 0; i < RINGS.length; i++) if (d <= RINGS[i] + STONE_R * 0.5) return i;
  return -1;
}

function setupEnd(s: CurlingState) {
  s.stones = [];
  s.thrown = 0;
  s.current = -1;
  // two to four red stones: some guarding in front of the house, some inside it
  const n = 2 + s.rng.int(0, Math.min(2, s.end));
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const guard = s.rng.int(0, 99) < 40;
    const x = s.rng.int(-18, 18) * FP;
    const y = (guard ? HOUSE_Y - s.rng.int(40, 80) : HOUSE_Y + s.rng.int(-16, 16)) * FP;
    if (s.stones.some((o) => dist2(o.x, o.y, x, y) < (STONE_R * 2 + 2) ** 2)) continue;
    const st: Stone = { red: true, x, y, vx: 0, vy: 0, out: false, wasIn: false };
    st.wasIn = ringOf(st) >= 0;
    s.stones.push(st);
  }
  startThrow(s);
}

function startThrow(s: CurlingState) {
  s.phase = "aim";
  s.t = 0;
  s.curl = s.rng.int(0, 1) ? 1 : -1;
  s.sweeping = false;
}

function tallyEnd(s: CurlingState) {
  let pts = 0;
  for (const st of s.stones) {
    if (st.out) continue;
    const r = ringOf(st);
    if (!st.red && r >= 0) pts += RING_POINTS[r];
  }
  for (const st of s.stones) if (st.red && st.wasIn && (st.out || ringOf(st) < 0)) (pts += KNOCK_POINTS), s.knocked++;
  s.endScores.push(pts);
  s.score = s.endScores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) * 10;
}

/** Move every stone one frame; returns true while any stone still moves. */
function physics(s: CurlingState): boolean {
  let moving = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.stones.length; i++) {
    const st = s.stones[i];
    if (st.out || (st.vx === 0 && st.vy === 0)) continue;
    moving = true;
    const swept = i === s.current && s.sweeping;
    const fr = swept ? SWEEP_FRICTION : FRICTION;
    // friction along the motion, curl across it (only the thrown stone spins)
    const sp = Math.sqrt((st.vx / FP) ** 2 + (st.vy / FP) ** 2) * FP;
    if (sp <= fr) {
      st.vx = 0;
      st.vy = 0;
    } else {
      st.vx -= Math.round((st.vx * fr) / sp);
      st.vy -= Math.round((st.vy * fr) / sp);
      if (i === s.current && s.t % (swept ? CURL_EVERY_SWEPT : CURL_EVERY) === 0) st.vx += s.curl;
    }
    st.x += st.vx;
    st.y += st.vy;
    if (Math.abs(st.x) > (SHEET_HALF - STONE_R) * FP || st.y > BACK_Y * FP) {
      st.out = true;
      st.vx = st.vy = 0;
    }
  }
  // collisions: equal masses, the normal parts of the velocities swap
  for (let i = 0; i < s.stones.length; i++) {
    const a = s.stones[i];
    if (a.out) continue;
    for (let j = i + 1; j < s.stones.length; j++) {
      const b = s.stones[j];
      if (b.out) continue;
      const dx = (b.x - a.x) / FP;
      const dy = (b.y - a.y) / FP;
      const d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
      if (d2 >= (STONE_R * 2) ** 2 || d2 === 0) continue;
      const rvx = (a.vx - b.vx) / FP;
      const rvy = (a.vy - b.vy) / FP;
      const along = (rvx * dx + rvy * dy) / d2;
      if (along <= 0) continue; // already parting
      const ix = Math.trunc(along * dx * FP * 0.92);
      const iy = Math.trunc(along * dy * FP * 0.92);
      a.vx -= ix;
      a.vy -= iy;
      b.vx += ix;
      b.vy += iy;
      // push apart so they don't stay locked together
      const d = Math.sqrt(d2);
      const push = Math.trunc(((STONE_R * 2 - d) / 2 / d) * FP);
      a.x -= Math.trunc(push * dx);
      a.y -= Math.trunc(push * dy);
      b.x += Math.trunc(push * dx);
      b.y += Math.trunc(push * dy);
      moving = true;
    }
  }
  return moving;
}

export const FrostCurling: Game<CurlingState> = {
  id: "frost-curling",
  maxFrames: MAX_FRAMES,
  actions: [ACT.down, ACT.up],
  init(seed) {
    const s: CurlingState = {
      frame: 0,
      rng: new Rng(seed),
      end: 0,
      thrown: 0,
      phase: "aim",
      t: 0,
      aim: 0,
      power: 0,
      curl: 1,
      holding: false,
      sweeping: false,
      stones: [],
      current: -1,
      endScores: [],
      knocked: 0,
      score: 0,
      over: false,
    };
    setupEnd(s);
    return s;
  },
  step(s, actions) {
    if (s.over) return;
    for (const a of actions) {
      if (a === ACT.down) {
        s.holding = true;
        if (s.phase === "aim" && s.t > 10) {
          s.aim = aimAt(s.t);
          s.phase = "power";
          s.t = 0;
        } else if (s.phase === "power" && s.t > 10) {
          s.power = powerAt(s.t);
          // release the stone from the hack
          const st: Stone = {
            red: false,
            x: 0,
            y: 8 * FP,
            vx: Math.trunc((s.aim * AIM_MAX) / 1000),
            vy: V_MIN + Math.trunc(((V_MAX - V_MIN) * s.power) / 1000),
            out: false,
            wasIn: false,
          };
          s.stones.push(st);
          s.current = s.stones.length - 1;
          s.thrown++;
          s.phase = "slide";
          s.t = 0;
        }
      } else if (a === ACT.up) s.holding = false;
    }
    s.sweeping = s.phase === "slide" && s.holding;
    s.t++;
    if (s.phase === "slide") {
      if (!physics(s)) {
        s.phase = "settle";
        s.t = 0;
        s.sweeping = false;
      }
    } else if (s.phase === "settle" && s.t >= 75) {
      if (s.thrown >= STONES_PER_END) {
        tallyEnd(s);
        s.phase = "tally";
        s.t = 0;
      } else startThrow(s);
    } else if (s.phase === "tally" && s.t >= 120) {
      s.end++;
      if (s.end >= ENDS) s.over = true;
      else setupEnd(s);
    }
    s.frame++;
    if (s.frame >= MAX_FRAMES) s.over = true;
  },
  over(s) {
    return s.over;
  },
  score(s) {
    return s.score;
  },
};

export function hashCurling(s: CurlingState): number {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  h = mix(h, s.frame);
  h = mix(h, s.score);
  h = mix(h, s.end);
  h = mix(h, s.thrown);
  h = mix(h, s.rng.state);
  for (const st of s.stones) (h = mix(h, st.x)), (h = mix(h, st.y));
  return h;
}
```

`src/games/drones.ts`:

```ts
// Drone Range: a target hangar on a space station. Red drones fly in and close on you; shoot them before
// they get near enough to fire. Gold drones take two hits and pay more. Green courier drones are friendly:
// hit one and it costs a shield. Eight rounds, then the gun reloads (or reload early).
// The field is screen space, 0..255 across and down in 1/256 steps, so every device plays the same game.
// A shot is one action that carries its aim: SHOT_BASE + u * 256 + v.

import { type Game, Rng, mix } from "../engine.ts";
import { isin } from "./vineswing.ts";

export const FP = 256;
export const ACT = { reload: 1 } as const;
export const SHOT_BASE = 1000;
export const shotAction = (u: number, v: number) => SHOT_BASE + (u & 255) * 256 + (v & 255);
export const AMMO = 8;
export const SHIELDS = 3;
export const RELOAD = 48; // frames
export const NEAR = 46 * FP; // a red drone this big is close enough to fire
const MAX_FRAMES = 60 * 240;
const TURN = 1 << 20;

export type Kind = "red" | "gold" | "green";
export interface Drone {
  id: number;
  kind: Kind;
  x: number; // FP, 0..255
  y: number;
  vx: number;
  vy: number;
  r: number; // FP radius on screen; grows as it closes in
  dr: number;
  hp: number;
  wob: number; // wobble phase
  t: number;
}

export interface DronesState {
  frame: number;
  rng: Rng;
  drones: Drone[];
  nextId: number;
  spawnIn: number;
  ammo: number;
  reloading: number; // frames left, 0 = ready
  shields: number;
  combo: number;
  bestCombo: number;
  hits: number;
  shots: number;
  couriersHit: number;
  /** what just happened (for sound and sparks): kind, screen spot, frame */
  last: { e: "hit" | "kill" | "miss" | "courier" | "zap" | "reload" | "empty"; x: number; y: number; at: number } | null;
  end: "down" | "time" | null;
  score: number;
}

function spawn(s: DronesState) {
  const lvl = Math.min(1, s.frame / (60 * 150)); // ramps over two and a half minutes
  const roll = s.rng.int(0, 99);
  const kind: Kind = roll < 14 ? "green" : roll < 26 + lvl * 8 ? "gold" : "red";
  // entry points: the two side doors, the ceiling vents, the far hatch in the middle
  const gate = s.rng.int(0, 3);
  let x: number, y: number, vx: number, vy: number;
  const sp = (60 + Math.floor(lvl * 90) + s.rng.int(0, 40)) | 0; // FP per frame
  if (gate === 0) (x = 4 * FP), (y = s.rng.int(70, 150) * FP), (vx = sp), (vy = s.rng.int(-20, 20));
  else if (gate === 1) (x = 251 * FP), (y = s.rng.int(70, 150) * FP), (vx = -sp), (vy = s.rng.int(-20, 20));
  else if (gate === 2) (x = s.rng.int(50, 205) * FP), (y = 8 * FP), (vx = s.rng.int(-40, 40)), (vy = sp >> 1);
  else (x = s.rng.int(100, 155) * FP), (y = s.rng.int(90, 120) * FP), (vx = s.rng.int(-60, 60)), (vy = s.rng.int(-30, 30));
  const green = kind === "green";
  s.drones.push({
    id: s.nextId++,
    kind,
    x,
    y,
    vx,
    vy,
    r: (green ? 14 : 10) * FP,
    // couriers cross and leave; hostiles close in, faster as the shift goes on
    dr: green ? 0 : 6 + Math.floor(lvl * 10) + s.rng.int(0, 4),
    hp: kind === "gold" ? 2 : 1,
    wob: s.rng.int(0, TURN - 1),
    t: 0,
  });
  s.spawnIn = Math.max(22, 80 - Math.floor(lvl * 50)) + s.rng.int(0, 30);
}

function note(s: DronesState, e: NonNullable<DronesState["last"]>["e"], x: number, y: number) {
  s.last = { e, x, y, at: s.frame };
}

function shoot(s: DronesState, u: number, v: number) {
  if (s.reloading) return;
  if (s.ammo <= 0) {
    s.reloading = RELOAD;
    note(s, "empty", u, v);
    return;
  }
  s.ammo--;
  s.shots++;
  // the nearest drone (largest on screen) under the shot takes it
  let hit: Drone | null = null;
  const px = u * FP + FP / 2;
  const py = v * FP + FP / 2;
  for (const d of s.drones) {
    const rr = d.r + 3 * FP; // a little forgiveness around the hull
    const dx = (d.x - px) / FP;
    const dy = (d.y - py) / FP;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= (rr / FP) ** 2 && (!hit || d.r > hit.r)) hit = d;
  }
  if (!hit) {
    s.combo = 0;
    note(s, "miss", u, v);
  } else if (hit.kind === "green") {
    s.couriersHit++;
    s.shields--;
    s.combo = 0;
    s.score = Math.max(0, s.score - 50);
    s.drones = s.drones.filter((d) => d !== hit);
    note(s, "courier", hit.x / FP, hit.y / FP);
  } else {
    hit.hp--;
    s.hits++;
    if (hit.hp > 0) note(s, "hit", hit.x / FP, hit.y / FP);
    else {
      s.combo++;
      s.bestCombo = Math.max(s.bestCombo, s.combo);
      // further away (smaller) is worth more: a quick shot beats a panicked one
      const far = Math.max(0, Math.floor((NEAR - hit.r) / (4 * FP)));
      s.score += (hit.kind === "gold" ? 30 : 10) + far + Math.min(10, s.combo) * 2;
      s.drones = s.drones.filter((d) => d !== hit);
      note(s, "kill", hit.x / FP, hit.y / FP);
    }
  }
  if (s.ammo === 0) s.reloading = RELOAD;
}

export const DroneRange: Game<DronesState> = {
  id: "drone-range",
  maxFrames: MAX_FRAMES,
  actions: [ACT.reload, SHOT_BASE],
  isAction: (a) => a === ACT.reload || (Number.isInteger(a) && a >= SHOT_BASE && a < SHOT_BASE + 65536),
  init(seed) {
    return {
      frame: 0,
      rng: new Rng(seed),
      drones: [],
      nextId: 1,
      spawnIn: 50,
      ammo: AMMO,
      reloading: 0,
      shields: SHIELDS,
      combo: 0,
      bestCombo: 0,
      hits: 0,
      shots: 0,
      couriersHit: 0,
      last: null,
      end: null,
      score: 0,
    };
  },
  step(s, actions) {
    if (s.end) return;
    for (const a of actions) {
      if (a === ACT.reload) {
        if (!s.reloading && s.ammo < AMMO) {
          s.reloading = RELOAD;
          note(s, "reload", 128, 128);
        }
      } else if (a >= SHOT_BASE) {
        const c = a - SHOT_BASE;
        shoot(s, c >> 8, c & 255);
      }
    }
    if (s.reloading && --s.reloading === 0) s.ammo = AMMO;

    if (--s.spawnIn <= 0) spawn(s);
    const keep: Drone[] = [];
    for (const d of s.drones) {
      d.t++;
      // drift with a wobble; hostiles home in toward the middle of the view as they close
      const w = isin(d.wob + d.t * 9000);
      d.x += d.vx + Math.trunc((w * 40) / 4096);
      d.y += d.vy + Math.trunc((isin(d.wob + d.t * 6000 + TURN / 4) * 24) / 4096);
      if (d.kind !== "green") {
        d.vx += Math.sign(128 * FP - d.x) * 2;
        d.vy += Math.sign(118 * FP - d.y) * 2;
        d.vx = Math.max(-200, Math.min(200, d.vx));
        d.vy = Math.max(-160, Math.min(160, d.vy));
      }
      d.r += d.dr;
      if (d.kind !== "green" && d.r >= NEAR) {
        s.shields--;
        s.combo = 0;
        note(s, "zap", d.x / FP, d.y / FP);
        continue;
      }
      const out = d.x < -20 * FP || d.x > 276 * FP || d.y < -20 * FP || d.y > 276 * FP;
      if (out) continue;
      keep.push(d);
    }
    s.drones = keep;
    if (s.shields <= 0) s.end = "down";
    s.frame++;
    if (!s.end && s.frame >= MAX_FRAMES) s.end = "time";
  },
  over(s) {
    return s.end !== null;
  },
  score(s) {
    return s.score;
  },
};

export function hashDrones(s: DronesState): number {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  h = mix(h, s.frame);
  h = mix(h, s.score);
  h = mix(h, s.shields);
  h = mix(h, s.hits);
  h = mix(h, s.shots);
  h = mix(h, s.drones.length);
  h = mix(h, s.rng.state);
  return h;
}
```

`src/games/dune.ts`:

```ts
// Dune Skimmer: sandboard down an endless dune field in a sandstorm. Steer left and right; crests throw you
// into the air when you're fast enough, and in the air you clear rocks you'd otherwise hit. Crystals are
// worth points. Hit a rock or a ruin pillar on the ground and the run ends.
// Integer-only physics (positions in 1/256 px) so the Worker replays it exactly.
// Axes: z = distance down the field, x = across (-LANE..LANE), y = height.

import { type Game, Rng, mix } from "../engine.ts";
import { icos } from "./vineswing.ts";

export const FP = 256;
export const ACT = { leftDown: 1, leftUp: 2, rightDown: 3, rightUp: 4 } as const;
export const LANE = 64; // px either side of the centre line
export const ROCK_R = 7;
export const ROCK_H = 11; // px: clear this much air over a rock and you pass it
export const PILLAR_R = 6;
export const PILLAR_H = 60;
export const CRYSTAL_R = 7;
const CRYSTAL_SCORE = 25;

const TURN = 1 << 20;
const G = 5; // FP px per frame^2
const STEER = 70; // FP px per frame^2 of sideways push on the sand
const SIDE_MAX = 640; // FP px per frame
const MAX_FRAMES = 60 * 240;

export interface Dune {
  z: number; // px where it starts
  len: number; // px
  amp: number; // px of crest height
}
export type Thing =
  | { kind: "rock"; x: number; z: number; r: number }
  | { kind: "arch"; x: number; z: number; gap: number } // two pillars at x - gap and x + gap
  | { kind: "crystal"; x: number; z: number; y: number; taken: boolean };

export interface DuneState {
  frame: number;
  rng: Rng;
  left: boolean;
  right: boolean;
  x: number; // FP
  z: number; // FP
  y: number; // FP height
  vx: number;
  vy: number;
  speed: number; // FP px per frame, down the field
  grounded: boolean;
  air: number; // frames in the air on the current jump
  jumps: number;
  dunes: Dune[];
  things: Thing[];
  crystals: number;
  end: "crash" | "time" | null;
  hit: { x: number; z: number } | null;
  score: number;
}

/** Ground height in FP at a distance in FP. */
export function groundAt(s: { dunes: Dune[] }, zfp: number): number {
  const z = zfp / FP;
  for (const d of s.dunes) {
    if (z < d.z) return 0;
    if (z < d.z + d.len) {
      const dz = zfp - d.z * FP;
      const a = Math.trunc((dz * TURN) / (d.len * FP));
      return Math.trunc((d.amp * FP * (4096 - icos(a))) / 8192);
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

function addDune(s: DuneState) {
  const last = s.dunes[s.dunes.length - 1];
  const z = last ? last.z + last.len : 0;
  const far = Math.min(1, z / 40000);
  s.dunes.push({ z, len: s.rng.int(300, 520), amp: s.rng.int(14, 30) + Math.floor(far * s.rng.int(0, 16)) });
}

function lastThingZ(s: DuneState) {
  return s.things.length ? s.things[s.things.length - 1].z : 260;
}

function addRow(s: DuneState) {
  const z0 = lastThingZ(s);
  const far = Math.min(1, z0 / 50000);
  const z = z0 + s.rng.int(90, 140) - Math.floor(far * 30);
  const roll = s.rng.int(0, 99);
  if (roll < 14) {
    // an old arch: pass between its pillars
    s.things.push({ kind: "arch", x: s.rng.int(-30, 30), z, gap: s.rng.int(20, 26) });
    return;
  }
  // one to three rocks, always leaving a gap at least 34 px wide somewhere across the lane
  const n = 1 + (s.rng.int(0, 99) < 45 + far * 30 ? 1 : 0) + (s.rng.int(0, 99) < far * 40 ? 1 : 0);
  const gapAt = s.rng.int(-LANE + 20, LANE - 20);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let x = s.rng.int(-LANE + 6, LANE - 6);
    if (Math.abs(x - gapAt) < 24) x = gapAt + (x < gapAt ? -26 : 26);
    s.things.push({ kind: "rock", x, z: z + s.rng.int(-8, 8), r: ROCK_R + s.rng.int(0, 3) });
  }
  // crystals: a short line through the gap, some of them up in the air over a crest
  if (s.rng.int(0, 99) < 60) {
    const high = s.rng.int(0, 99) < 35;
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) s.things.push({ kind: "crystal", x: gapAt, z: z + 30 + k * 16, y: high ? 16 + k * 4 : 4, taken: false });
  }
}

export const DuneSkimmer: Game<DuneState> = {
  id: "dune-skimmer",
  maxFrames: MAX_FRAMES,
  actions: [ACT.leftDown, ACT.leftUp, ACT.rightDown, ACT.rightUp],
  init(seed) {
    const s: DuneState = {
      frame: 0,
      rng: new Rng(seed),
      left: false,
      right: false,
      x: 0,
      z: 0,
      y: 0,
      vx: 0,
      vy: 0,
      speed: 520,
      grounded: true,
      air: 0,
      jumps: 0,
      dunes: [],
      things: [],
      crystals: 0,
      end: null,
      hit: null,
      score: 0,
    };
    while (!s.dunes.length || s.dunes[s.dunes.length - 1].z < 1500) addDune(s);
    while (lastThingZ(s) < 900) addRow(s);
    return s;
  },
  step(s, actions) {
    if (s.end) return;
    for (const a of actions) {
      if (a === ACT.leftDown) s.left = true;
      else if (a === ACT.leftUp) s.left = false;
      else if (a === ACT.rightDown) s.right = true;
      else if (a === ACT.rightUp) s.right = false;
    }
    // speed builds from 2 to 4.6 px per frame over about three minutes
    if (s.speed < 1180 && s.frame % 16 === 0) s.speed += 1;
    // steering: full grip on the sand, a little in the air; the board straightens when you let go
    const steer = (s.right ? 1 : 0) - (s.left ? 1 : 0);
    const grip = s.grounded ? STEER : STEER >> 2;
    if (steer) s.vx += steer * grip;
    else s.vx -= Math.trunc(s.vx / (s.grounded ? 6 : 24));
    s.vx = Math.max(-SIDE_MAX, Math.min(SIDE_MAX, s.vx));
    s.x += s.vx;
    const lim = LANE * FP;
    if (s.x < -lim) (s.x = -lim), (s.vx = 0);
    if (s.x > lim) (s.x = lim), (s.vx = 0);

    // down the field; the ground falling away faster than gravity throws you off a crest
    const g0 = groundAt(s, s.z);
    s.z += s.speed;
    const g1 = groundAt(s, s.z);
    if (s.grounded) {
      const follow = g1 - g0;
      const ballistic = s.vy - G;
      if (follow < ballistic - 2) {
        s.grounded = false;
        s.vy = ballistic;
        s.y += s.vy;
        s.air = 0;
      } else {
        s.vy = follow;
        s.y = g1;
      }
    } else {
      s.vy -= G;
      s.y += s.vy;
      s.air++;
      if (s.y <= g1) {
        s.y = g1;
        s.vy = g1 - g0;
        s.grounded = true;
        if (s.air > 20) s.jumps++;
      }
    }

    const px = Math.floor(s.x / FP);
    const pz = Math.floor(s.z / FP);
    const lift = Math.floor((s.y - g1) / FP); // height above the sand
    for (const t of s.things) {
      if (t.z > pz + 20) break;
      if (Math.abs(t.z - pz) > 14) continue;
      if (t.kind === "rock") {
        if (lift < ROCK_H && (t.x - px) ** 2 + (t.z - pz) ** 2 < (t.r + 4) ** 2) (s.end = "crash"), (s.hit = { x: t.x, z: t.z });
      } else if (t.kind === "arch") {
        for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
          const cx = t.x + side * t.gap;
          if (lift < PILLAR_H && (cx - px) ** 2 + (t.z - pz) ** 2 < (PILLAR_R + 4) ** 2) (s.end = "crash"), (s.hit = { x: cx, z: t.z });
        }
      } else if (!t.taken && (t.x - px) ** 2 + (t.z - pz) ** 2 <= (CRYSTAL_R + 5) ** 2 && Math.abs(lift - t.y) <= 12) {
        t.taken = true;
        s.crystals++;
      }
    }
    while (s.dunes[s.dunes.length - 1].z < pz + 1500) addDune(s);
    while (s.dunes.length > 2 && s.dunes[0].z + s.dunes[0].len < pz - 200) s.dunes.shift();
    while (lastThingZ(s) < pz + 900) addRow(s);
    while (s.things.length && s.things[0].z < pz - 60) s.things.shift();
    s.score = Math.floor(pz / 8) + s.crystals * CRYSTAL_SCORE;
    s.frame++;
    if (!s.end && s.frame >= MAX_FRAMES) s.end = "time";
  },
  over(s) {
    return s.end !== null;
  },
  score(s) {
    return s.score;
  },
};

export function hashDune(s: DuneState): number {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  h = mix(h, s.frame);
  h = mix(h, s.score);
  h = mix(h, s.x);
  h = mix(h, s.z);
  h = mix(h, s.y);
  h = mix(h, s.rng.state);
  return h;
}

```

`src/games/hooddash.ts`:

```ts
// Hood Dash: a hooded runner crosses the town's rooftops. Press to jump; press again in the air for one
// short second jump. Gaps between roofs and chimneys end the run. Speed rises the longer you last.
// Integer-only physics in 1/256 px (FP). The view is 160 x 240; the runner stays at screen x = 36.

import { type Game, Rng, mix } from "../engine.ts";

export const FP = 256;
export const ACTION_JUMP = 1;
export const RUNNER_X = 36; // px from the left edge of the view
export const RUNNER_W = 8;
export const RUNNER_H = 12;
export const FALL_Y = 260; // px; falling past this ends the run

const MAX_FRAMES = 60 * 240;
const GRAVITY = 40; // FP per frame^2
const JUMP_V = 900; // first jump
const JUMP2_V = 720; // second jump, shorter
const START_SPEED = 360; // FP per frame (~1.4 px)
const MAX_SPEED = 840; // ~3.3 px
const SPEED_EVERY = 90; // frames per speed step
const SPEED_STEP = 6;
const COIN_SCORE = 25;
const COIN_R = 6; // px pickup radius

export interface Roof {
  x0: number; // px, world
  x1: number;
  y: number; // px, roof top (screen-down)
  chimney: number; // px world x of a chimney on this roof, or -1
}

export type DashEnd = "fall" | "wall" | "chimney" | "time" | null;

export interface HoodDashState {
  frame: number;
  rng: Rng;
  x: number; // FP world x of the runner's left edge
  y: number; // FP feet y
  vy: number;
  speed: number;
  grounded: boolean;
  airJump: boolean;
  roofs: Roof[];
  coins: { x: number; y: number; taken: boolean }[];
  coinsTaken: number;
  jumps: number;
  end: DashEnd;
  score: number;
}

const CHIMNEY_W = 8;
const CHIMNEY_H = 12;

function genRoof(s: HoodDashState) {
  const prev = s.roofs[s.roofs.length - 1];
  const px = s.speed / FP;
  // The widest gap a first jump clears at the current speed is about 45 frames * speed; stay well inside it.
  const maxGap = Math.min(64, Math.floor(28 * px));
  const gap = s.rng.int(14, Math.max(16, maxGap));
  const w = s.rng.int(56, 150);
  const rise = s.rng.int(-22, 18); // negative = higher roof
  const y = Math.max(140, Math.min(204, prev.y + rise));
  const x0 = prev.x1 + gap;
  const roof: Roof = { x0, x1: x0 + w, y, chimney: -1 };
  if (w >= 80 && s.rng.int(0, 99) < 45) roof.chimney = x0 + s.rng.int(36, w - 24);
  s.roofs.push(roof);
  if (s.rng.int(0, 99) < 60) {
    const cx = x0 + s.rng.int(10, w - 10);
    const lift = s.rng.int(0, 1) ? 26 : 44; // low coins on the roof, high ones need a jump
    if (roof.chimney < 0 || Math.abs(cx - roof.chimney) > 16) s.coins.push({ x: cx, y: y - lift, taken: false });
  }
}

function roofUnder(s: HoodDashState, xpx: number): Roof | null {
  for (const r of s.roofs) if (xpx + RUNNER_W > r.x0 && xpx < r.x1) return r;
  return null;
}

export const HoodDash: Game<HoodDashState> = {
  id: "hood-dash",
  maxFrames: MAX_FRAMES,
  actions: [ACTION_JUMP],
  init(seed) {
    const s: HoodDashState = {
      frame: 0,
      rng: new Rng(seed),
      x: 0,
      y: 180 * FP,
      vy: 0,
      speed: START_SPEED,
      grounded: true,
      airJump: true,
      roofs: [{ x0: -RUNNER_X, x1: 220, y: 180, chimney: -1 }],
      coins: [],
      coinsTaken: 0,
      jumps: 0,
      end: null,
      score: 0,
    };
    while (s.roofs[s.roofs.length - 1].x1 < 600) genRoof(s);
    return s;
  },
  step(s, actions) {
    if (s.end) return;
    for (const a of actions) {
      if (a !== ACTION_JUMP) continue;
      if (s.grounded) {
        s.vy = -JUMP_V;
        s.grounded = false;
        s.airJump = true;
        s.jumps++;
      } else if (s.airJump) {
        s.vy = -JUMP2_V;
        s.airJump = false;
        s.jumps++;
      }
    }
    if (s.frame % SPEED_EVERY === SPEED_EVERY - 1) s.speed = Math.min(MAX_SPEED, s.speed + SPEED_STEP);

    const oldFeet = s.y;
    s.x += s.speed;
    const xpx = Math.floor(s.x / FP);
    if (!s.grounded) {
      s.vy += GRAVITY;
      s.y += s.vy;
    }
    const roof = roofUnder(s, xpx);
    if (roof) {
      const top = roof.y * FP;
      if (s.grounded) {
        if (s.y !== top) {
          // ran onto a different roof while grounded: step down is a fall, step up is a wall
          if (top < s.y) s.end = "wall";
          else s.grounded = false;
        }
      } else if (s.vy >= 0 && oldFeet <= top && s.y >= top) {
        s.y = top;
        s.vy = 0;
        s.grounded = true;
        s.airJump = true;
      } else if (s.y > top + 2 * FP && oldFeet > top) {
        s.end = "wall"; // hit the side of a taller building
      }
      if (!s.end && roof.chimney >= 0) {
        const feet = Math.floor(s.y / FP);
        const overlapX = xpx + RUNNER_W > roof.chimney && xpx < roof.chimney + CHIMNEY_W;
        if (overlapX && feet > roof.y - CHIMNEY_H) s.end = "chimney";
      }
    } else if (s.grounded) {
      s.grounded = false;
    }
    if (!s.end && s.y > FALL_Y * FP) s.end = "fall";

    // coins
    const cyPx = Math.floor(s.y / FP) - RUNNER_H / 2;
    for (const c of s.coins) {
      if (c.taken) continue;
      if (Math.abs(c.x - (xpx + RUNNER_W / 2)) <= COIN_R && Math.abs(c.y - cyPx) <= COIN_R + 2) {
        c.taken = true;
        s.coinsTaken++;
      }
    }
    // keep the world ahead generated, drop what's far behind
    while (s.roofs[s.roofs.length - 1].x1 < xpx + 400) genRoof(s);
    while (s.roofs.length > 2 && s.roofs[0].x1 < xpx - 100) s.roofs.shift();
    while (s.coins.length && s.coins[0].x < xpx - 100) s.coins.shift();

    s.score = Math.floor(xpx / 4) + s.coinsTaken * COIN_SCORE;
    s.frame++;
    if (!s.end && s.frame >= MAX_FRAMES) s.end = "time";
  },
  over(s) {
    return s.end !== null;
  },
  score(s) {
    return s.score;
  },
};

export function hashHoodDash(s: HoodDashState): number {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  h = mix(h, s.frame);
  h = mix(h, s.score);
  h = mix(h, s.x);
  h = mix(h, s.y);
  h = mix(h, s.rng.state);
  h = mix(h, s.coinsTaken);
  return h;
}

export const DASH_CHIMNEY = { w: CHIMNEY_W, h: CHIMNEY_H };
```

```ts
// Every playable game, keyed by id. The Worker replays submissions through this table.
import type { Game, InputEvent } from "../engine.ts";
import { Bullseye, type BullseyeState, hashBullseye } from "./bullseye.ts";
import { CoinStack, type CoinStackState, hashCoinStack } from "./coinstack.ts";
import { HoodDash, type HoodDashState, hashHoodDash } from "./hooddash.ts";
import { type KartState, SCORE_CAP_MS, hashKart, makeKart } from "./kart.ts";
import { VineSwing, type VineSwingState, hashVineSwing } from "./vineswing.ts";
import { ReefDive, type ReefDiveState, hashReefDive } from "./reefdive.ts";
import { DuneSkimmer, type DuneState, hashDune } from "./dune.ts";
import { HarborBrawl, type BrawlState, hashBrawl } from "./brawl.ts";
import { DroneRange, type DronesState, hashDrones } from "./drones.ts";
import { FrostCurling, type CurlingState, hashCurling } from "./curling.ts";

export interface Entry<S> {
  game: Game<S>;
  hash: (s: S) => number;
  /** Patterns that look scripted. A flagged run waits for review instead of going on the board. */
  flags: (s: S, events: readonly InputEvent[]) => string[];
}

const coinStack: Entry<CoinStackState> = {
  game: CoinStack,
  hash: hashCoinStack,
  flags(s, events) {
    const out: string[] = [];
    const coins = s.stack.length - 1;
    if (coins >= 25 && s.perfects / coins > 0.85) out.push("perfect_rate");
    if (coins > 150) out.push("tall_stack");
    // Human drop timing drifts; a script that waits a fixed delay after each landing does not.
    if (events.length >= 20) {
      const gaps: number[] = [];
      for (let i = 1; i < events.length; i++) gaps.push(events[i][0] - events[i - 1][0]);
      const mean = gaps.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / gaps.length;
      const sd = Math.sqrt(gaps.reduce((a, b) => a + (b - mean) ** 2, 0) / gaps.length);
      if (mean > 0 && sd / mean < 0.04) out.push("even_timing");
    }
    return out;
  },
};

const hoodDash: Entry<HoodDashState> = {
  game: HoodDash,
  hash: hashHoodDash,
  flags(s) {
    const out: string[] = [];
    // Past this distance the runner is at top speed for minutes; worth a look before it tops the board.
    if (s.x / 256 > 30000) out.push("long_run");
    return out;
  },
};

const bullseye: Entry<BullseyeState> = {
  game: Bullseye,
  hash: hashBullseye,
  flags(s) {
    const out: string[] = [];
    if (s.shots.length >= 15 && s.tens / s.shots.length > 0.8) out.push("perfect_rate");
    return out;
  },
};

const vineSwing: Entry<VineSwingState> = {
  game: VineSwing,
  hash: hashVineSwing,
  flags(s, events) {
    const out: string[] = [];
    // a look-ahead bot that never misses a good moment reaches about 700 catches in the full four minutes
    if (s.catches > 600) out.push("long_run");
    if (events.length > 6000) out.push("input_flood");
    return out;
  },
};

const reefDive: Entry<ReefDiveState> = {
  game: ReefDive,
  hash: hashReefDive,
  flags(s, events) {
    const out: string[] = [];
    // only a look-ahead bot reliably lasts the full four minutes
    if (s.end === "time") out.push("long_run");
    if (events.length > 6000) out.push("input_flood");
    return out;
  },
};

const dune: Entry<DuneState> = {
  game: DuneSkimmer,
  hash: hashDune,
  flags(s, events) {
    const out: string[] = [];
    // a look-ahead bot lasts the four minutes; few people will
    if (s.end === "time") out.push("long_run");
    if (events.length > 8000) out.push("input_flood");
    return out;
  },
};

const brawl: Entry<BrawlState> = {
  game: HarborBrawl,
  hash: hashBrawl,
  flags(s, events) {
    const out: string[] = [];
    // a bot that parries every tell frame-perfectly reaches about rival 9 in four minutes
    if (s.round >= 10) out.push("deep_run");
    if (s.parries >= 20 && s.parries / Math.max(1, s.parries + s.kos * 3) > 0.8) out.push("parry_rate");
    if (events.length > 8000) out.push("input_flood");
    return out;
  },
};

const drones: Entry<DronesState> = {
  game: DroneRange,
  hash: hashDrones,
  flags(s, events) {
    const out: string[] = [];
    // people miss now and then; near-perfect aim over many shots is worth a look
    if (s.shots >= 80 && s.hits / s.shots > 0.97) out.push("aim_rate");
    if (s.end === "time") out.push("long_run");
    if (events.length > 6000) out.push("input_flood");
    return out;
  },
};

const curling: Entry<CurlingState> = {
  game: FrostCurling,
  hash: hashCurling,
  flags(s, events) {
    const out: string[] = [];
    // a timing bot that never misses lands about 30 points an end; a run of near-perfect ends is worth a look
    if (s.endScores.length >= 3 && s.endScores.every((x) => x >= 40)) out.push("perfect_ends");
    if (events.length > 6000) out.push("input_flood");
    return out;
  },
};

// Cobble Kart: a finish faster than these (ms) is beyond what a line-following bot reaches; hold it for review.
const KART_PAR: Record<string, number> = { square: 41000, canal: 49000, clock: 50500 };
const kart = (key: string): Entry<KartState> => ({
  game: makeKart(key),
  hash: hashKart,
  flags(s, events) {
    const out: string[] = [];
    if (s.finished && SCORE_CAP_MS - makeKart(key).score(s) < KART_PAR[key]) out.push("fast_finish");
    if (events.length > 4000) out.push("input_flood");
    return out;
  },
});

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
export const REGISTRY: Record<string, Entry<any>> = {
  "coin-stack": coinStack,
  "hood-dash": hoodDash,
  "bullseye-wind": bullseye,
  "vine-swing": vineSwing,
  "reef-dive": reefDive,
  "dune-skimmer": dune,
  "harbor-brawl": brawl,
  "drone-range": drones,
  "frost-curling": curling,
  "kart-square": kart("square"),
  "kart-canal": kart("canal"),
  "kart-clock": kart("clock"),
};
```
