`src/games/kart.ts`:

```ts
// Cobble Kart: a time trial on a closed street circuit. The kart accelerates on its own; hold left or
// right to steer. Off the cobbles (past the kerb) it slows to a crawl. Three laps, fastest time wins.
// Integer-only: position in 1/256 px (FP), heading in 1/1024 of a turn, trig from an integer table.
// The progress check walks the centreline segment by segment, so cutting a corner never counts.

import { type Game, mix } from "../engine.ts";
import { TRACKS, type TrackData } from "./kart-tracks.ts";

export const FP = 256;
export const TURN = 1024; // heading units per full turn
export const LAPS = 3;
export const COUNTDOWN = 120; // frames before the lights go green
export const ACT = { leftDown: 1, leftUp: 2, rightDown: 3, rightUp: 4 } as const;
/** A finish time t (ms) is stored as SCORE_CAP_MS - t, so a faster lap is a higher score and the boards,
 * prizes and profiles that rank by highest score need no special case. 0 means no finish. */
export const SCORE_CAP_MS = 600_000;

const MAX_FRAMES = COUNTDOWN + 60 * 180;
const V_MAX = 3 * FP; // on the cobbles, per frame
const V_OFF = FP; // off the track
const ACCEL = 7;
const DRAG_OFF = 22; // per frame while above V_OFF off track
const STEER = 10; // heading units per frame at low speed
const STEER_FAST = 7; // at top speed
const SCRUB = 2; // speed lost per frame while steering

// sin(a) * 4096 for a in [0, 1024), from Bhaskara's integer approximation (max error about 0.2%).
// Plain integer and double arithmetic, so every engine builds the same table.
const SIN = new Int32Array(TURN);
for (let a = 0; a < TURN; a++) {
  const half = a & 511;
  const u = half * (512 - half);
  const v = Math.floor((4096 * 16 * u) / (5 * 262144 - 4 * u));
  SIN[a] = a < 512 ? v : -v;
}
const sin = (a: number) => SIN[a & (TURN - 1)];
const cos = (a: number) => SIN[(a + 256) & (TURN - 1)];

export interface KartState {
  frame: number;
  track: string;
  x: number; // FP
  y: number; // FP
  head: number; // 0..1023
  v: number; // FP per frame
  left: boolean;
  right: boolean;
  seg: number; // centreline segment the kart is on
  lap: number; // laps completed
  lapFrames: number[]; // frame each lap was completed on
  offFrames: number; // frames spent off the track
  finished: boolean;
  offTrack: boolean;
}

const n = (t: TrackData) => t.pts.length / 2;
const px = (t: TrackData, i: number) => t.pts[2 * (((i % n(t)) + n(t)) % n(t))];
const py = (t: TrackData, i: number) => t.pts[2 * (((i % n(t)) + n(t)) % n(t)) + 1];

/** Is point (x, y) (px) within `r` of segment i? Integer only: compares squares, no division. */
function near(t: TrackData, i: number, x: number, y: number, r: number): boolean {
  const ax = px(t, i), ay = py(t, i), bx = px(t, i + 1), by = py(t, i + 1);
  const dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay;
  const wx = x - ax, wy = y - ay;
  const len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  const dot = wx * dx + wy * dy;
  if (dot <= 0) return wx * wx + wy * wy <= r * r;
  if (dot >= len2) {
    const ex = x - bx, ey = y - by;
    return ex * ex + ey * ey <= r * r;
  }
  const cross = wx * dy - wy * dx;
  return cross * cross <= r * r * len2;
}
/** Has the point passed the end of segment i (projection beyond its far end)? */
function past(t: TrackData, i: number, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const ax = px(t, i), ay = py(t, i), bx = px(t, i + 1), by = py(t, i + 1);
  const dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay;
  return (x - ax) * dx + (y - ay) * dy >= dx * dx + dy * dy;
}

export function makeKart(trackKey: string): Game<KartState> {
  const t = TRACKS[trackKey];
  return {
    id: "kart-" + trackKey,
    maxFrames: MAX_FRAMES,
    actions: [ACT.leftDown, ACT.leftUp, ACT.rightDown, ACT.rightUp],
    init() {
      // the seed is unused: a time trial is the same track for everyone
      return {
        frame: 0,
        track: trackKey,
        x: px(t, 0) * FP,
        y: py(t, 0) * FP,
        head: t.head,
        v: 0,
        left: false,
        right: false,
        seg: 0,
        lap: 0,
        lapFrames: [],
        offFrames: 0,
        finished: false,
        offTrack: false,
      };
    },
    step(s, actions) {
      for (const a of actions) {
        if (a === ACT.leftDown) s.left = true;
        else if (a === ACT.leftUp) s.left = false;
        else if (a === ACT.rightDown) s.right = true;
        else if (a === ACT.rightUp) s.right = false;
      }
      s.frame++;
      if (s.frame <= COUNTDOWN) return;

      const steer = (s.right ? 1 : 0) - (s.left ? 1 : 0);
      if (steer !== 0) {
        const rate = STEER - (((STEER - STEER_FAST) * s.v) / V_MAX) | 0;
        s.head = (s.head + steer * rate + TURN) & (TURN - 1);
        s.v = Math.max(0, s.v - SCRUB);
      }
      const cx = s.x >> 8;
      const cy = s.y >> 8;
      let on = false;
      for (let k = -1; k <= 2 && !on; k++) if (near(t, s.seg + k, cx, cy, t.hw)) on = true;
      s.offTrack = !on;
      if (on) s.v = Math.min(V_MAX, s.v + ACCEL);
      else {
        s.offFrames++;
        s.v = s.v > V_OFF ? Math.max(V_OFF, s.v - DRAG_OFF) : Math.min(V_OFF, s.v + ACCEL);
      }
      s.x += (s.v * cos(s.head)) >> 12;
      s.y += (s.v * sin(s.head)) >> 12;

      // progress: move to the next segment only while close to the line and past the current one's end
      const nx = s.x >> 8;
      const ny = s.y >> 8;
      for (let guard = 0; guard < 3; guard++) {
        if (!past(t, s.seg, nx, ny) || !near(t, s.seg + 1, nx, ny, t.hw * 2)) break;
        s.seg++;
        if (s.seg >= n(t)) {
          s.seg = 0;
          s.lap++;
          s.lapFrames.push(s.frame - COUNTDOWN);
          if (s.lap >= LAPS) s.finished = true;
        }
      }
    },
    over: (s) => s.finished || s.frame >= MAX_FRAMES,
    score: (s) => (s.finished ? Math.max(1, SCORE_CAP_MS - framesToMs(s.lapFrames[LAPS - 1])) : 0),
  };
}

export const framesToMs = (f: number) => Math.floor((f * 1000) / 60);
/** 1:02.35 style, from milliseconds. */
export function fmtTime(ms: number): string {
  const m = Math.floor(ms / 60000);
  const s = Math.floor((ms % 60000) / 1000);
  const c = Math.floor((ms % 1000) / 10);
  return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, "0")}.${String(c).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}
/** Score back to the finish time it encodes. */
export const scoreToMs = (score: number) => SCORE_CAP_MS - score;

export function hashKart(s: KartState): number {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (const v of [s.frame, s.x, s.y, s.head, s.v, s.seg, s.lap, s.offFrames, ...s.lapFrames]) h = mix(h, v);
  return h;
}

export const TRACK_KEYS = Object.keys(TRACKS);
export { TRACKS };

```

`src/games/reefdive.ts`:

```ts
// Reef Dive: a diver swims right through a coral reef. Hold to dive, let go to float back up.
// Coral grows from the seabed, fishing hooks hang from the surface, jellyfish drift up and down between them.
// Air runs out below the surface and refills at the top. Pearls are worth points. One touch ends the dive.
// Integer-only physics (positions in 1/256 px) so the Worker replays it exactly. View: 160 x 240 px.

import { type Game, Rng, mix } from "../engine.ts";
import { isin } from "./vineswing.ts";

export const FP = 256;
export const ACT = { dive: 1, rise: 2 } as const;
export const VIEW_X = 48; // screen x of the diver
export const SURFACE_Y = 34; // px: the water line; the diver can't go above it
export const SEABED_Y = 222; // px: sand
export const DIVER_R = 6; // px: hit circle
export const JELLY_R = 8;
export const PEARL_R = 7;
export const AIR_MAX = 60 * 11; // frames of air
const AIR_REFILL = 8; // per frame at the surface
const PEARL_SCORE = 25;

const DIVE = 54; // FP px per frame^2 while held
const RISE = 42; // buoyancy when let go
const MAX_FRAMES = 60 * 240;
const TURN = 1 << 20;

export type Obstacle =
  | { kind: "coral"; x: number; w: number; top: number } // from `top` down to the seabed
  | { kind: "hook"; x: number; depth: number } // a line from the surface down to a hook at `depth`
  | { kind: "jelly"; x: number; base: number; amp: number; phase: number; speed: number };

export interface ReefDiveState {
  frame: number;
  rng: Rng;
  holding: boolean;
  x: number; // FP
  y: number; // FP
  vy: number; // FP per frame
  speed: number; // FP px per frame, forward
  air: number; // frames left
  obstacles: Obstacle[];
  pearls: { x: number; y: number; taken: boolean }[];
  pearlsTaken: number;
  passed: number;
  end: "coral" | "hook" | "jelly" | "air" | "time" | null;
  score: number;
}

/** Jelly centre y in px for a frame (integer bob along the shared sine table). */
export function jellyY(j: { base: number; amp: number; phase: number; speed: number }, frame: number): number {
  return j.base + Math.trunc((j.amp * isin(j.phase + frame * j.speed)) / 4096);
}

function nextX(s: ReefDiveState): number {
  const last = s.obstacles[s.obstacles.length - 1];
  return last ? last.x + (last.kind === "coral" ? last.w : 0) : 220;
}

function addObstacle(s: ReefDiveState) {
  const prevX = nextX(s);
  const far = Math.min(1, prevX / 9000);
  // gaps shrink a little with distance, but never below what a full dive-to-float swing needs
  const gap = s.rng.int(84, 112) - Math.floor(far * 18);
  const x = prevX + gap;
  const roll = s.rng.int(0, 99);
  let o: Obstacle;
  if (roll < 40) o = { kind: "coral", x, w: s.rng.int(14, 24), top: SEABED_Y - s.rng.int(36, 82 + Math.floor(far * 14)) };
  else if (roll < 68) o = { kind: "hook", x, depth: SURFACE_Y + s.rng.int(46, 96 + Math.floor(far * 12)) };
  else {
    const amp = s.rng.int(10, 26 + Math.floor(far * 10));
    o = { kind: "jelly", x, base: s.rng.int(SURFACE_Y + 40 + amp, SEABED_Y - 24 - amp), amp, phase: s.rng.int(0, TURN - 1), speed: s.rng.int(4000, 7000) };
  }
  s.obstacles.push(o);
  // a pearl in most gaps, somewhere a diver can reach
  if (s.rng.int(0, 99) < 60) {
    const deep = s.rng.int(0, 99) < 45;
    const py = deep ? SEABED_Y - s.rng.int(8, 15) : s.rng.int(SURFACE_Y + 24, SEABED_Y - 40);
    s.pearls.push({ x: prevX + Math.floor(gap / 2) + s.rng.int(-8, 8), y: py, taken: false });
  }
}

function hits(s: ReefDiveState, hx: number, hy: number): ReefDiveState["end"] {
  for (const o of s.obstacles) {
    if (o.x > hx + 40) break;
    if (o.kind === "coral") {
      // circle vs box
      const cx = Math.max(o.x, Math.min(hx, o.x + o.w));
      const cy = Math.max(o.top, Math.min(hy, SEABED_Y));
      if ((hx - cx) ** 2 + (hy - cy) ** 2 < DIVER_R * DIVER_R) return "coral";
    } else if (o.kind === "hook") {
      if (Math.abs(hx - o.x) < DIVER_R + 1 && hy < o.depth + 4) return "hook";
    } else {
      const jy = jellyY(o, s.frame);
      const r = DIVER_R + JELLY_R - 2;
      if ((hx - o.x) ** 2 + (hy - jy) ** 2 < r * r) return "jelly";
    }
  }
  return null;
}

export const ReefDive: Game<ReefDiveState> = {
  id: "reef-dive",
  maxFrames: MAX_FRAMES,
  actions: [ACT.dive, ACT.rise],
  init(seed) {
    const s: ReefDiveState = {
      frame: 0,
      rng: new Rng(seed),
      holding: false,
      x: 40 * FP,
      y: (SURFACE_Y + 6) * FP,
      vy: 0,
      speed: 300,
      air: AIR_MAX,
      obstacles: [],
      pearls: [],
      pearlsTaken: 0,
      passed: 0,
      end: null,
      score: 0,
    };
    while (nextX(s) < 700) addObstacle(s);
    return s;
  },
  step(s, actions) {
    if (s.end) return;
    for (const a of actions) s.holding = a === ACT.dive;
    // swim: hold pushes down, the water lifts you when you let go; drag keeps it smooth
    s.vy += s.holding ? DIVE : -RISE;
    s.vy -= s.vy >> 4;
    s.y += s.vy;
    if (s.y < SURFACE_Y * FP) {
      s.y = SURFACE_Y * FP;
      if (s.vy < 0) s.vy = 0;
    }
    if (s.y > (SEABED_Y - DIVER_R) * FP) {
      s.y = (SEABED_Y - DIVER_R) * FP;
      if (s.vy > 0) s.vy = 0;
    }
    // speed builds from 1.2 to 2.3 px per frame over the first two minutes
    if (s.speed < 590 && s.frame % 25 === 0) s.speed += 2;
    s.x += s.speed;
    const hx = Math.floor(s.x / FP);
    const hy = Math.floor(s.y / FP);
    // air: refills at the surface, drains below
    if (hy <= SURFACE_Y + 3) s.air = Math.min(AIR_MAX, s.air + AIR_REFILL);
    else s.air--;
    for (const p of s.pearls) {
      if (p.taken) continue;
      if ((p.x - hx) ** 2 + (p.y - hy) ** 2 <= (PEARL_R + DIVER_R) ** 2) {
        p.taken = true;
        s.pearlsTaken++;
      }
    }
    const hit = hits(s, hx, hy);
    if (hit) s.end = hit;
    else if (s.air <= 0) s.end = "air";
    while (nextX(s) < hx + 420) addObstacle(s);
    while (s.obstacles.length && s.obstacles[0].x < hx - 120) {
      s.obstacles.shift();
      s.passed++;
    }
    while (s.pearls.length && s.pearls[0].x < hx - 120) s.pearls.shift();
    s.score = Math.floor((hx - 40) / 4) + s.pearlsTaken * PEARL_SCORE;
    s.frame++;
    if (!s.end && s.frame >= MAX_FRAMES) s.end = "time";
  },
  over(s) {
    return s.end !== null;
  },
  score(s) {
    return s.score;
  },
};

export function hashReefDive(s: ReefDiveState): number {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  h = mix(h, s.frame);
  h = mix(h, s.score);
  h = mix(h, s.x);
  h = mix(h, s.y);
  h = mix(h, s.vy);
  h = mix(h, s.air);
  h = mix(h, s.rng.state);
  return h;
}

```

`src/games/vineswing.ts`:

```ts
// Vine Swing: swing through a jungle canopy. Tap to let go and fly; the hands grab the next vine they pass. Fruit in the air is worth points. Miss every vine and you drop into the river.
// Integer-only physics (positions in 1/256 px, angles in 1/2^20 of a turn) so the Worker replays it exactly.
// The view is 160 x 240 px; the swinger stays near screen x = 52.

import { type Game, Rng, mix } from "../engine.ts";

export const FP = 256;
export const ACT = { hold: 1, release: 2 } as const;
export const VIEW_X = 52;
export const CANOPY_Y = 26; // px: where every vine hangs from
export const RIVER_Y = 232; // px: falling past this ends the run
export const REACH = 28; // px: how close to a vine the hands must pass to catch it
export const FRUIT_R = 8;
const FRUIT_SCORE = 25;

const TURN = 1 << 20;
const G = 100; // gravity, FP px per frame^2
const MAX_FRAMES = 60 * 240;
const PUMP = 40; // angle units per frame^2 of pump while hanging on
const RAD = 166886;
const MAX_FLY = 900; // FP px per frame: top launch speed (~3.5 px) // angle units per radian (2^20 / 2pi), rounded

// sine table: 1024 steps per turn, scaled to 4096. Bhaskara I's approximation, integers only.
const SIN = new Int32Array(1024);
for (let i = 0; i < 1024; i++) {
  const d = (i % 512) * 180; // degrees * 512
  const x = d * (180 * 512 - d);
  const v = Math.floor((4 * x * 4096) / (40500 * 512 * 512 - x));
  SIN[i] = i < 512 ? v : -v;
}
const idx = (a: number) => ((((a >> 10) % 1024) + 1024) % 1024) | 0;
export const isin = (a: number) => SIN[idx(a)];
export const icos = (a: number) => SIN[(idx(a) + 256) & 1023];

export interface Vine {
  x: number; // px, anchor
  len: number; // px
}

export interface VineSwingState {
  frame: number;
  rng: Rng;
  mode: "swing" | "fly";
  holding: boolean;
  vine: number; // index into vines while swinging
  ropeLen: number; // px from the anchor to the hands while swinging
  ang: number; // angle from straight down, + = toward +x
  w: number; // angular speed, angle units per frame
  x: number; // FP hands position
  y: number;
  vx: number; // FP per frame, while flying
  vy: number;
  vines: Vine[];
  fruit: { x: number; y: number; taken: boolean }[];
  fruitTaken: number;
  catches: number;
  best: number; // px: furthest x reached
  end: "river" | "time" | null;
  score: number;
}

function addVine(s: VineSwingState) {
  const prev = s.vines[s.vines.length - 1];
  const far = Math.min(1, prev.x / 6000);
  const gap = s.rng.int(58, 82) + Math.floor(far * s.rng.int(0, 28));
  const v: Vine = { x: prev.x + gap, len: s.rng.int(70, 120) };
  s.vines.push(v);
  if (s.rng.int(0, 99) < 55) {
    const fx = prev.x + Math.floor(gap / 2) + s.rng.int(-10, 10);
    const fy = CANOPY_Y + s.rng.int(70, 150);
    s.fruit.push({ x: fx, y: fy, taken: false });
  }
}

/** Angle of the point (dx, dy) seen from an anchor, measured from straight down. */
function angleOf(dx: number, dy: number): number {
  // search the table for the closest direction; 1024 steps is plenty for a catch
  let best = 0;
  let bestErr = Infinity;
  for (let i = 0; i < 1024; i++) {
    const err = Math.abs(dx * SIN[(i + 256) & 1023] - dy * SIN[i]);
    // same side as the point: sin has the sign of dx, cos the sign of dy
    if (Math.sign(SIN[i]) !== Math.sign(dx) && dx !== 0) continue;
    if (SIN[(i + 256) & 1023] < 0 && dy > 0) continue;
    if (err < bestErr) {
      bestErr = err;
      best = i;
    }
  }
  const a = best << 10;
  return a >= TURN / 2 ? a - TURN : a;
}

function place(s: VineSwingState) {
  const v = s.vines[s.vine];
  s.x = v.x * FP + Math.trunc((s.ropeLen * FP * isin(s.ang)) / 4096);
  s.y = CANOPY_Y * FP + Math.trunc((s.ropeLen * FP * icos(s.ang)) / 4096);
}

function tryCatch(s: VineSwingState): boolean {
  const hx = Math.floor(s.x / FP);
  const hy = Math.floor(s.y / FP);
  for (let i = 0; i < s.vines.length; i++) {
    if (i === s.vine) continue; // let go of this one: catch another
    const v = s.vines[i];
    if (Math.abs(hx - v.x) > REACH) continue;
    if (hy < CANOPY_Y + 14 || hy > CANOPY_Y + v.len + 32) continue;
    // hang on where the hands met the vine; keep the speed, turned into a swing
    const dx = hx - v.x;
    const dy = hy - CANOPY_Y;
    const len = Math.max(24, Math.min(v.len, Math.floor(Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy))));
    s.vine = i;
    s.ropeLen = len;
    s.ang = angleOf(dx, dy);
    // tangential speed (px per frame) = v . (cos a, -sin a); angular speed = that / len
    const tang = Math.trunc((s.vx * icos(s.ang) - s.vy * isin(s.ang)) / 4096); // FP px per frame
    s.w = Math.trunc((tang * RAD) / (len * FP));
    s.mode = "swing";
    s.catches++;
    place(s);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export const VineSwing: Game<VineSwingState> = {
  id: "vine-swing",
  maxFrames: MAX_FRAMES,
  actions: [ACT.hold, ACT.release],
  init(seed) {
    const s: VineSwingState = {
      frame: 0,
      rng: new Rng(seed),
      mode: "swing",
      holding: true,
      vine: 0,
      ropeLen: 90,
      ang: -Math.floor(TURN / 6), // start pulled back, 60 degrees
      w: 0,
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      vx: 0,
      vy: 0,
      vines: [{ x: 40, len: 90 }],
      fruit: [],
      fruitTaken: 0,
      catches: 0,
      best: 0,
      end: null,
      score: 0,
    };
    while (s.vines[s.vines.length - 1].x < 700) addVine(s);
    place(s);
    return s;
  },
  step(s, actions) {
    if (s.end) return;
    for (const a of actions) {
      if (a === ACT.hold) s.holding = true;
      else if (a === ACT.release) {
        s.holding = false;
        if (s.mode === "swing") {
          // fly off along the swing: v = w * len * (cos a, -sin a)
          // capped so quick catch-and-release chains can't build speed without limit
          const lin = Math.max(-MAX_FLY, Math.min(MAX_FLY, Math.trunc((s.w * s.ropeLen * FP) / RAD)));
          s.vx = Math.trunc((lin * icos(s.ang)) / 4096);
          s.vy = -Math.trunc((lin * isin(s.ang)) / 4096);
          s.mode = "fly";
        }
      }
    }
    if (s.mode === "swing") {
      // after a catch the hands slide down to the end of the vine, keeping their speed
      const full = s.vines[s.vine].len;
      if (s.ropeLen < full) {
        const next = Math.min(full, s.ropeLen + 3);
        s.w = Math.trunc((s.w * s.ropeLen) / next);
        s.ropeLen = next;
      }
      // pendulum: angular acceleration = -(g / len) sin(a), plus a little pump while the swing is small
      const acc = -Math.trunc((G * isin(s.ang) * RAD) / (4096 * s.ropeLen * FP));
      s.w += acc;
      // pump: while the swing has less energy than a 75 degree swing, each frame adds a little speed
      // (energy per unit mass, in px and frames: 1/2 L^2 w^2 + g L (1 - cos a); IEEE doubles are exact enough
      // and identical on every engine for + - * / and sqrt)
      const L = s.ropeLen;
      const wr = s.w / RAD;
      const e = 0.5 * L * L * wr * wr + (G / FP) * L * (1 - icos(s.ang) / 4096);
      const eTarget = (G / FP) * L * 0.74; // a 75 degree swing
      if (e < eTarget && s.w !== 0) s.w += Math.sign(s.w) * PUMP;
      s.ang += s.w;
      place(s);
    } else {
      s.vy += G;
      s.x += s.vx;
      s.y += s.vy;
      tryCatch(s); // the hands grab any vine they pass
      if (s.y > RIVER_Y * FP) s.end = "river";
    }
    const hx = Math.floor(s.x / FP);
    const hy = Math.floor(s.y / FP);
    if (hx > s.best) s.best = hx;
    for (const f of s.fruit) {
      if (f.taken) continue;
      if (Math.abs(f.x - hx) <= FRUIT_R && Math.abs(f.y - (hy + 8)) <= FRUIT_R + 4) {
        f.taken = true;
        s.fruitTaken++;
      }
    }
    while (s.vines[s.vines.length - 1].x < hx + 400) addVine(s);
    // drop what's far behind, keeping the index of the vine in hand valid
    while (s.vines.length > 3 && s.vines[0].x < hx - 160 && s.vine > 0) {
      s.vines.shift();
      s.vine--;
    }
    while (s.fruit.length && s.fruit[0].x < hx - 160) s.fruit.shift();
    s.score = Math.floor(Math.max(0, s.best - 40) / 4) + s.fruitTaken * FRUIT_SCORE;
    s.frame++;
    if (!s.end && s.frame >= MAX_FRAMES) s.end = "time";
  },
  over(s) {
    return s.end !== null;
  },
  score(s) {
    return s.score;
  },
};

export function hashVineSwing(s: VineSwingState): number {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  h = mix(h, s.frame);
  h = mix(h, s.score);
  h = mix(h, s.x);
  h = mix(h, s.y);
  h = mix(h, s.rng.state);
  h = mix(h, s.catches);
  return h;
}
```

`test/replay.test.ts`:

```ts
// Golden replays: fixed seeds and inputs must keep producing the same score, frame count and state hash.
// If a game's rules change on purpose, regenerate the fixtures in the same commit.
import { test } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { replay } from "../src/engine.ts";
import { REGISTRY } from "../src/games/index.ts";

type Fixture = { game?: string; seed: number; events: [number, number][]; expect: { score: number; frames: number; hash: number } };
const golden: Record<string, Fixture> = JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL("../fixtures/golden.json", import.meta.url), "utf8"));
const played: Fixture = JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL("../fixtures/coin-stack.json", import.meta.url), "utf8"));

for (const [id, f] of Object.entries(golden)) {
  test(`golden replay: ${id}`, () => {
    const e = REGISTRY[id];
    const r = replay(e.game, f.seed, f.events, e.hash);
    assert.ok(r.ok);
    assert.deepEqual({ score: r.score, frames: r.frames, hash: r.hash >>> 0 }, f.expect);
  });
}

test("a run played on the site replays to its stored result", () => {
  const e = REGISTRY[played.game!];
  const r = replay(e.game, played.seed >>> 0, played.events, e.hash);
  assert.ok(r.ok);
  assert.deepEqual({ score: r.score, frames: r.frames, hash: r.hash >>> 0 }, played.expect);
});

test("bad inputs are refused", () => {
  const e = REGISTRY["coin-stack"];
  assert.equal(replay(e.game, 1, [[10, 99]]).ok, false); // unknown action
  assert.equal(replay(e.game, 1, [[20, 1], [10, 1]]).ok, false); // unsorted
  assert.equal(replay(e.game, 1, [[-1, 1]]).ok, false); // bad frame
});

test("replay is pure: same input, same hash, twice", () => {
  for (const [id, f] of Object.entries(golden)) {
    const e = REGISTRY[id];
    const a = replay(e.game, f.seed, f.events, e.hash);
    const b = replay(e.game, f.seed, f.events, e.hash);
    assert.ok(a.ok && b.ok && a.hash === b.hash, id);
  }
});
```
